Title: Manager, Clinical Services
Description:
**Manager, Clinical Services – Intensive Services**

Full time-37.5 hours per week

***EveryMind Mental Health Services*** is currently recruiting for an experienced mental health professional with significant leadership experience in community healthcare for the position of **Manager, Clinical Services**.

***EveryMind*** is an accredited child and youth mental health organization that provides a continuum of high-quality mental health services for children, youth and their families who are experiencing or are at risk of experiencing mental health issues.

**Summary of Function**

Under the leadership of the Director, Clinical Services, the Manager is accountable for the effective delivery of services that are in keeping with the organization’s mission, vision, values, clinical and management philosophies, accreditation standards, policies, procedures and annual Service Plan. This position forms part of the Clinical Management Team responsible for supporting the clinical strategic direction, clinical decision-making and clinical policy development for EveryMind.

This portfolio is accountable to manage the organization’s Brief Services (Tangerine Single Session Counselling and One Stop Talk/Parlons maintenant), Counselling and Therapy Services, 24/7 Crisis Support and Respite Services. The Manager is responsible for ensuring trauma-informed/trauma-specific, evidence-based/evidence-informed practices are integrated across services, with a focus on supporting children, youth and families with complex mental health needs, including concurrent mental health and substance use disorders. The incumbent is responsible for direct supervision of up to 7 direct supervisor reports, for indirect management of up to 90 front line staff and accountability for an annual operating budget of approximately $7.5 million.

Annual Salary: Hiring range **$107,448 - $116,216 (step 1-3 in a 5 step pay band)**

Please note that hiring salaries are commensurate with experience and generally start at the beginning of the range.

***Why work at EveryMind?***

* Work for an organization that is the ***lead agency*** in child and youth mental health services for Region of Peel, known for our excellence in providing quality services.
* Contribute to the mental health & wellbeing of children and youth.
* A strong workplace wellness focus: ***4 weeks paid vacation***, **2 float days, 5 days Management compensatory time**, paid personal leave days, in addition to 11 paid public holidays.
* An Extended Health Plan that includes ***$1000 for mental health supports*** and a ***Flexible Health Spending Account.***
* An excellent extended health and dental benefits plan**,** ***all premiums fully paid by the employer, no co-pay required by the employee******.***
* Income protection Sick leave Plan and Life insurance.
* Free, confidential 24/7 counselling and mental health support for you and your family via our Employee and Family Assistance Program.
* An exceptional ***Retirement Plan*** where the employer contributes 7% equivalent of your salary to your personal pension plan.
* Enjoy exceptional training and development opportunities including an ***Education Assistance Plan*** to support employees in further education in their field.
* A workplace culture that embraces ***Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Anti-racism (DEIA)*** with employee-led internal committees focusing on Black Engagement, LGBTQ2S, Indigenous Knowledge.

**Responsibilities**

* **Operations**

* Provides administrative and/or clinical oversight and direction to the program areas of responsibility working collaboratively and cooperatively across the agency to create an integrated operational service.
* Oversees clinical accountability for Key Performance Indicators and reporting compliance to funders using data dashboards and other reporting tools.
* Leads operational efficiency within assigned portfolio through providing oversight to program Supervisors and direct service staff.
* Ensures compliance with relevant legislation, accreditation standards, policies and procedures and implements changes in the same, if any, all Occupational Health and Safety and Infection & Prevention Control (IPAC) requirements
* Participates in Clinical on Call coverage roster. Manages approved budgets, staffing and allocated resources in order to achieve the desirable deliverables, targets, goals and objectives.
* **Strategic Planning**

* In collaboration with the Director, provide input into the Organization’s clinical services strategic planning and educational learning plans decision-making and policy formulation processes.
* Ensure the delivery of high-quality clinical services through the integration of evidence informed/based practices and monitoring of program outcomes.
* Engages in continuous Quality Improvement activities to meet changing needs within both a virtual and in person operation framework in support of high-quality service provision.
* Contribute to the development of existing and new clinical services with a focus on growth for serving Marginalized and Racialized clients and their families
* **Training & Development**

* Identify, develop, implement professional training and development programs to enhance skill, knowledge and professional development of clinical teams across the organization.
* Support and encourage further organizational development through implementing and overseeing quality standards from Accreditation Canada and other best practices in partnership with the System Planning and Accountability Department.
* **Community and Funders**

* Maintain an awareness of community needs for services within portfolio and participates in community meetings, funder meetings and professional groups as required.
* Actively represent the organization, build and maintain positive working relationships with funding agencies, external organizations, service agencies and stakeholders clearly communicating the organizations goals and future directions.

**Knowledge, Education and Experience**

* Master’s Degree in Social Work, Psychotherapy, or other Health Professional Field with membership in the appropriate profession/regulated College.
* A minimum of seven years clinical experience, three of which must have been in a clinical leadership role, supervising a team of mental health professionals, preferably at the supervisory level.
* Strong knowledge of children and youth mental health sector and the related legislation.
* Demonstrated understanding of child and youth development, family systems, trauma, and concurrent disorders.
* Experience working with provincial government funders and funders’ accountabilities.
* Must have a strong understanding and knowledge of funder portals and reporting standards.
* Understanding and application of EMHware and the ChYMH suite of Clinical Assessment Tools, HEADS-ED and C-SSRS is an asset.
* Bilingualism in French and English is a definite asset.
* Proven collaborative leadership skills, with the ability to develop and articulate a clinical direction, gaining acceptance and buy-in of others in that direction.
* Demonstrated ability to work in partnership with others in terms of an integrated regional network of service delivery with other providers.
* Demonstrated ability to build cultural competence in clinical services and promote equitable and inclusive practices across the organization and its community partners
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Teams, Excel and Outlook, virtual platforms and experience with client information databases and reports.
* Ability to do After Hours On call duties in rotation with Clinical Management Team
* Valid Ontario Driver’s license (Class G) and use of a vehicle with a comfort in driving throughout the Peel region and surrounding areas.
* A Satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Police Check and Pre-Employment Medical screening (including TB test, COVID-19 Vaccination, MMR, TD, Polio Vaccination), is required.

Title: Senior Manager, Clinical & Operational Service
Description:
**Company Description**

Heart & Vascular Partners LLC ("HVP") is a leading national management services organization built to support independent cardiology and vascular practices. Founded by clinicians, for clinicians, HVP provides managed care contracting, facility development and operations, revenue cycle management, and marketing services through a national, scaled delivery platform.

HVP currently partners with practices across Oklahoma, Colorado, Illinois, Missouri, and Texas, and supports the management of ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager, Clinical & Operational Services is a hands-on, execution-focused role that carries assigned initiatives from field assessment through implementation and completion across HVP's partner practices and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs). The role spends significant time in the field working directly with practice and ASC teams to solve problems, implement clinical and operational improvements, and ensure completed work is adopted and sustained.

Approximately 25% of the role is dedicated to ASC quality, credentialing, and clinical compliance. A central responsibility is connecting ASC operations with the affiliated practice so workflows, provider credentialing, quality activities, and compliance needs are coordinated.

**Scope of the Role**

* Executes priorities assigned by the Chief Operating Officer and HVP leadership; this is a working role, not a strategy-setting position.
* Works alongside practice and ASC leaders without owning P&L, budgets, operational outcomes, or direct supervision of administrators.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Hands-on Implementation and Assigned Initiatives**

* Take assigned initiatives from field assessment through implementation, including building practical work plans, completing tasks, coordinating contributors, resolving issues, and closing out the work.
* Work directly with practice and ASC teams on site to understand current conditions and perform the detailed work needed to move initiatives forward.
* Maintain clear timelines, task ownership, and status updates; identify risks early and escalate barriers to the COO.
* Provide hands-on launch, implementation, and follow-up support, confirming that changes are completed, understood, and sustained.

**ASC Quality, Credentialing, and Clinical Compliance**

* Oversee ASC quality initiatives, quality reporting, and follow-through on identified improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate and monitor ASC provider credentialing and recredentialing, working with credentialing teams, ASC leaders, physicians, and affiliated practices to keep files complete and current.
* Connect ASC operations with the affiliated practice so clinical workflows, provider schedules, credentialing, quality activities, and compliance requirements are aligned.
* Support accreditation, licensure, and regulatory survey readiness, including preparation, on-site support, and tracking corrective action plans through completion.
* Monitor clinical compliance needs and implement practical corrective actions, policies, training, and documentation.
* Coordinate ASC leader communications and support assigned inventory, supply, vendor, and compliance initiatives.

**Clinical Workflows and Operational Improvement**

* Assess current workflows on site and identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization.
* Implement standardized clinical and operational workflows while allowing appropriate practice-level flexibility.
* Work with practice administrators, clinical managers, and physicians to improve clinic flow, scheduling, and care coordination.
* Document workflows and create playbooks, reference guides, and standard operating procedures.

**Training and Change Support**

* Develop and deliver training for new workflows, systems, and processes.
* Create training materials, competency tools, and reference guides.
* Support practices and ASCs through change by being present, responsive, and hands-on during transitions.

**Field Presence and Practice Support**

* Maintain a regular, visible presence at partner practices and ASCs to assess needs, support implementations, and confirm project completion.
* Bring field feedback back to HVP leadership so priorities reflect real practice needs.
* Serve as a dependable, go-to resource for practice and ASC teams.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Other duties as assigned, including limited support for technology implementations or provider transitions when needed.

**Essential Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to organize and carry multiple assigned initiatives through completion while performing detailed work directly with field teams.
* Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach with strong follow-through.
* Highly organized and detail oriented.
* Clear, practical communicator with clinic staff, administrators, physicians, and leadership.
* Ability to build trust and influence without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of clinical operations, preferably in cardiovascular or specialty care.
* Working knowledge of healthcare regulatory, credentialing, quality, and accreditation requirements, including HIPAA, OSHA, state ASC licensure, and CMS Conditions for Coverage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Clinical Sciences, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in healthcare operations, clinical operations, or ASC operations.
* Demonstrated experience carrying implementations, quality initiatives, or process improvements from assessment through completion.
* Experience working directly with physicians and clinical teams.
* Ability to travel 30–50% and work on site at partner practices, ASCs, and the HVP office.

**Preferred**

* Clinical license (RN, NP, PA, RT, or other allied health professional).
* Experience in a multi-site healthcare organization, MSO, or ASC environment.
* Experience supporting ASC credentialing, accreditation, quality programs, or regulatory surveys.
* Quality improvement, healthcare compliance, or execution-focused training or certification, such as Lean or Six Sigma.

**Work Environment, Travel, and Physical Demands**

This role works in the HVP office, at partner practices and ASCs, and in clinical environments. In-office presence and regular, in-person field engagement are expected.

Travel to partner practice and ASC locations is required, estimated at 30–50% of the time, and will vary based on project timelines and practice needs. Attendance at company-wide meetings is expected at least once per quarter.

The employee is regularly required to see, talk, hear, stand, walk, and use hands. Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds may be required.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Title: VP, Construction & ETO
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across the construction and ETO portfolio, building the kind of trust that keeps retention high in one of the firm's most demanding verticals
* Champion delivery excellence for construction and ETO engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standard
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic construction and ETO accounts
* Take direct ownership of reducing escalations - since this industry generates a disproportionate share of the firm's escalations today, this is one of the clearest measures of your impact
* Partner with the product team to shape a stronger, more tailored customer experience for construction and ETO clients
* Build a delivery organization with genuine credibility in front of construction and ETO clients, coaching your internal team and hiring externally to bring in the industry expertise clients expect
* Act as a true partner to the SOS team, giving them the delivery support and credibility they need to win and grow construction and ETO business
* Turn strong delivery into growth, supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities and referenceable relationships
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same discipline you bring to client satisfaction and escalation management

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A blend of backgrounds: hands-on experience in construction, civil engineering, or ETO manufacturing, paired with time spent inside an IT or software company - you've operated credibly in both worlds, and that combination is non-negotiable for this role
* A degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical field is strongly preferred; an MBA or equivalent business degree is a plus
* Working fluency in construction-specific business processes - job costing, percentage-of-completion accounting, change order management, RFIs, submittals, and subcontractor/vendor management — and how they translate into ERP and project system requirements
* Exposure to construction-focused ERP/field platforms (e.g., Procore, Viewpoint/Vista, Sage 300 CRE, CMiC, Foundation) is a strong plus, alongside broader ERP/CRM experience such as NetSuite or Salesforce
* 10+ years in Professional Services or construction/ETO industry leadership, with 7-8 of those years in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering for construction or engineering-driven organizations
* A track record of managing distributed delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent, complex projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including genuine fluency in reading and acting on job-cost reporting and P&L
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for site visits and client needs

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A rare blend of construction industry experience and enterprise technology delivery background - you've credibly operated in both worlds, not just one
* A track record of reducing escalations and stabilizing delivery in complex, industry-specific engagements
* Strong executive presence with construction and ETO clients who expect a partner who understands their business, not just their software
* Experience partnering with product and sales teams to shape offerings and win business in a specialized vertical
* A reputation in the industry that opens doors - clients and prospects recognize your name before you walk into the room

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Escalations originating from construction and ETO accounts trend consistently downward under your leadership
* Your portfolio's false-start and early-termination rate holds well below the firm's threshold
* Clients recognize your delivery team as genuine construction and ETO experts, not generalists applying a standard playbook
* Sales consistently reports strong, proactive support from Delivery on construction and ETO opportunities, and the partnership shows up in win rates
* Your product feedback loop measurably improves the customer experience for construction and ETO clients over time

Description:

433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.
* Certification professionnelle PMP (Project Management Professional), PMI-RMP (PMI Risk Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), CCP (Certified Cost Professional), Lean Six Sigma ou certification équivalente

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Leadership transversal et capacité à influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en résolution structurée de problèmes et solide jugement professionnel.
* Sens des responsabilités, rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Capacité à remettre en question de façon constructive, à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à escalader les enjeux avec clarté lorsque nécessaire.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication avec la haute direction et capacité à présenter des analyses et recommandations fondées sur les données.
* Mentalité d’amélioration continue et engagement envers l’apprentissage organisationnel et le partage des meilleures pratiques.

Title: Operations Manager – Engineering & Construction [Saudi Nationality only] "URGENT HIRING"

Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.

**What you will do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What you will bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's in it for you**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.

***\*Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.***

Title: Tech Lead - Conversational AI & Driver Automation
Description:

We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi-channel chatbots, and a production-grade multi-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. + Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice-to-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation-to-human ratios.

* Conversational AI & Chatbots

+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real-time chat channels.
+ Own the four-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.

* Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver-facing apps via secure, event-driven patterns.
* Agentic AI & SOP Automation

+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs-as-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine-readable policies executed by the multi-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.

* AWS Infrastructure & MLOps

+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.
+ Define observability standards — per-agent-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.
+ Lead capacity and cost planning as interaction volumes scale across driver and operations channels.

* R&D & Innovation

+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof-of-concept with clear go/no-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team-wide use

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end-to-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.
* Ownership without ego: defines problems, architects solutions, ships results — accountable for outcomes across the full platform, not just assigned tickets.
* Operational intelligence: understands the business context of driver support, logistics operations, and the real cost of failure in real-time systems.
* Senior communicator: articulates trade-offs (agent reliability vs. automation rate, cost vs. latency) clearly to non-engineers and influences roadmap decisions through clarity of thought.
* Structured under ambiguity: brings process and rigor to fast-moving R&D environments where requirements evolve alongside the build.
* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.
* Collaborative and direct: raises architectural risks early, pushes back on under-specified requirements, and surfaces trade-offs before they become delivery blockers.

**Conversational AI & LLMs (Core)**

* Deep experience with AWS Bedrock — Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and model invocation; strong preference for Claude Sonnet/Opus via Bedrock.
* Multi-agent system design: orchestration patterns, agents-as-tools, inter-agent handoffs, context propagation, and failure isolation.
* Prompt engineering: system prompt design, structured output, tool-use, multi-turn reasoning, eval-driven iteration, and red-teaming for safety.
* Structured rules engines: condition/operator/value schemas for deterministic, noninterpretive decision logic — mandatory in production agentic systems.
* RAG pipelines: embedding models, vector databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), hybrid retrieval, and knowledge base tuning.

**IVR & Voice**

* IVR architecture: call flow design, intent/slot management, DTMF handling, escalationto-human routing, and SLA monitoring.
* Experience with STT/TTS pipelines or voice bot platforms is a strong plus.

**AWS Services (Core)**

* Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch — event-driven and serverless architectures.
* AWS Bedrock Agents: agent creation, alias management, tool action group configuration, and Guardrail policy management.
* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.
* CI/CD for AI services: prompt versioning, agent config deployment pipelines, automated evals, and rollback gates.

**Backend & Engineering**

* Python — async, OOP, clean code; REST API design with FastAPI or Flask.
* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
* Salesforce integration (APIs, events, data sync) is a strong plus.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**

* Knowledge of logistics, food delivery, or real-time operations domains.
* Arabic language NLP or experience building for Arabic-speaking markets.
* Familiarity with open-weight model inference (Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace Transformers).
* Exposure to multi-modal AI or voice-first interaction design.

Title: Director of Finance & Administration
Description:
**Compensation:**

Salary range: $145- $155K annually. Casey Trees offers excellent benefits including health, dental, vision, flexible spending account, paid holidays, paid time off, and retirement plan 403 (b). This position is eligible for 457 plan (deferred compensation plan).

**About Casey Trees**

In pursuit of our mission to plant and protect trees in the National Capital Region for the wellbeing of the communities we serve, Casey Trees (CT) delivers a broad base of programs and services to the DC Metro area. The organization plants more than 7,000 trees each year grown at our own nursery; cares and maintains those trees; conserves greenspace; conducts school and community-based youth STEM programming; and advocates for stronger policies and laws to preserve trees across the area. Casey Trees emphasizes innovative solutions and working with diverse partners to advance and promote tree canopy solutions that meet the needs of the communities that we serve.

**Summary**

The Director of Finance & Administration is a member of the Casey Trees leadership team and is responsible for the planning, oversight, and implementation of the organization’s financial strategy, financial reporting, compliance, and administration functions, including facilities, vehicle fleet, IT infrastructure and processes, and office operations. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director serves as a strategic partner to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and senior leadership team, and represents Finance and Administration in leadership, board, and related organizational meetings and events. The Director, ideally a Certified Public Accountant, leads and develops an in-house finance team, maintains strong internal controls, and manages key internal and external relationships, including with the audit firm, outside accountants, and investment managers, with the goal of ensuring that Casey Trees has the financial infrastructure, insight, and stewardship it needs to maintain and grow operations. As a team member of our nonprofit organization, the incumbent advocates for Casey Trees’ mission, vision, and values centered around people, trees, and spaces.

**Financial Strategy & Leadership**

* Provide vision, leadership, and oversight for Casey Trees’ financial and administrative functions to ensure the organization’s financial health, regulatory compliance, and operational readiness as it grows
* Serve as a strategic financial advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and senior leadership team, translating financial data into insight that informs program investment, risk management, and long-range decisions
* Represent Finance and Administration in leadership team, board, and committee meetings, and support the Chief Financial Officer in presenting financial results, forecasts, and risks to the Board of Directors
* Works across departments as a trusted partner who helps colleagues understand the financial implications of their strategies to help foster sound decision-making
* Stay current on trends and developments in nonprofit accounting standards, federal grant compliance, endowment and investment management, and organizational and cyber risk

**Team Leadership & Financial Operations Oversight**

* Supervise, mentor, and develop a growing team, which will include an Accounting & Finance Manager and the Administration Manager; set annual goals, hold regular check-ins, and conduct performance reviews
* Own the general ledger and oversee the month-end close, reviewing and approving the journal entries and account reconciliations prepared by the finance team, and ensure accurate, timely monthly financial statements
* Manage the relationship and scope of work with the outside accounting firm, which provides backup and independent oversight
* Maintain strong internal controls and segregation of duties across the finance team for both money coming in and money going out, including review of deposits and receivable adjustments, approval of new vendors and changes to vendor banking information, and release of payments
* Review and approve the monthly bank, credit card, and credit card processor reconciliations, and aging receivables, including any credits, write-offs, or adjustments
* Serve as administrator for the accounts payable and expense management systems

**Financial Planning and Analysis**

* Lead the annual budget process in collaboration with the Chief Financial Officer and department directors, aligning resources with organizational priorities and the strategic plan
* Oversee monthly budget-to-actual reports, cash flow forecasts, reforecasting, and projection analysis, and deliver clear analysis and recommendations to executives and the Board of Directors
* Prepare multi-year financial projections and scenario analyses

**Audit, Tax, and Compliance**

* Manage the annual audit, federal single audit, and Form 990 filing
* Ensure compliance with the Federal Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200) for all federal awards
* Oversee the calendar of local, state, and federal filings and registrations, including charitable solicitation registrations, and ensure timely submission

**Management of Restricted Revenue/Grant Revenue**

* Partner with development staff and program directors on grant budgets, and oversee grant invoicing, drawdowns, and financial reports to funders.
* Provide grant financial reports to support tracking of the grant portfolio
* Ensure restricted and grant revenue is accurately recorded, tracked, and released in accordance with donor restrictions and GAAP

Title: Operations Manager (Food Operations)
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
The Operations Manager (Food Operations) owns end-to-end food delivery service quality across the platform, specifically driving ETA promise accuracy, minimizing lateness, and reducing order cancellations. Since most operational levers sit within partner teams (Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply), this role operates through rigorous data-driven diagnosis, cross-functional prioritization, and strategic influence rather than direct operational control. Leading a direct team of 6 compliance specialists, the Operations Manager translates high-level service quality targets into actionable initiative portfolios, robust supply-hour requirements, and sustainable marketplace growth.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
**Service Quality & KPI Ownership**

* Own the daily monitoring, weekly review, and detailed root-cause analysis of food delivery metrics across key drivers (prep time, handover timer, distance, zone dynamics, and supply levels).
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for stream targets, including order volume growth (OPU), Mashallah (perfect) order rate, on-time delivery, cancellation rate, and short-distance speed SLAs.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all cross-functional lateness, cancellation, and delivery quality issues.

**Initiative Portfolio & Pilot Management**

* Manage and execute the strategic initiative portfolio: adjust ETA promises, eliminate merchant/zone inefficiencies, speed up merchant dispatch, and tune courier product features.
* Size initiative impacts, assign functional owners, define explicit deadlines, and evaluate pilot results before granting go/no-go approval for full production rollout.
* Collaborate with the Vertical Profitability Manager to establish and enforce strict quality guardrails (TDT, contact rate, lateness, cancellations) for profitability initiatives such as order bundling.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**

* Logistics & Product Alignment: Work with Logistics Algorithms and Product teams to adjust ETA/DPT accuracy, conduct elasticity tests, manage promotion-day promise adjustments, and enhance courier tools.
* Commerce & Merchant Quality: Partner with Commerce to reduce vendor prep and handover delays, adjust dispatch fitting for complex locations, and enforce merchant quality standards.
* Supply & Fleet Management: Translate service quality targets into precise supply-hour requirements for the Supply Team to drive full-timer (FT) courier acquisition and fleet capacity.

**Team Leadership & Direct Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and guide a direct team of 6 Compliance specialists based in Pakistan.
* Set clear individual performance targets, oversee daily audit workflows, and ensure team alignment with overarching platform quality goals.

**First 90 Days Roadmap & Execution**

* Day 30 (Diagnostics): Complete diagnostic mapping of lateness and cancellation drivers; build comprehensive KPI baselines and size/prioritize the initiative portfolio.
* Day 60 (Pilots): Launch 2–3 live pilots across Logistics, Product, and Commerce; establish weekly cross-functional governance cadences and finalize quality guardrails.
* Day 90 (Production Rollout): Evaluate pilots via go/no-go decisions, transition successful initiatives into production with defined owners and deadlines, and lock in long-term stream targets.

* Experience: 5+ years (or 3+ years for strong Middle candidate) in operations, logistics, or marketplace management within on-demand delivery, quick commerce, ride-hailing, or top-tier management consulting.
* Track Record: Proven record of measurably driving core operational metrics (on-time performance, cancellation reduction, ETA promise accuracy).
* Analytical Expertise: Strong capability in data analysis, dashboard building, root-cause investigation, and A/B test design/interpretation. Proficiency in SQL, Python, or Tableau/BI tools is highly advantageous.
* Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional cross-functional project coordination and communication skills; ability to deliver outcomes without direct hierarchical authority.
* Language & Location: Fluent English required. Readiness to relocate to Doha, Qatar. GCC market experience and Arabic language proficiency are strong advantages.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
**Strategic Scope & Work Environment Requirements**

* Cross-Functional Influence & Leadership: Proven ability to drive outcomes across Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply teams without direct organizational authority.
* Data-Driven Problem Solving: Continuous monitoring, order-level analytics, and root-cause analysis to pinpoint inefficiencies across prep times, handover delays, zone quality, and dispatch algorithms.

Title: Head of Marketing - APILayer / Filestack
Description:
About the Role  
We are looking for a senior Head of Marketing to lead marketing for two brands: APILayer and Filestack.  
This leader sets the strategy for both, runs a lean multidisciplinary team, and is accountable for traffic,  
pipeline and revenue across a self-service and enterprise business.  
  
APILayer is a portfolio of mainly self-service API products running across a large network of websites.  
The top priority there is awareness: growing brand visibility and top-of-funnel traffic across the network,  
while keeping every site's funnel healthy from first visit to signup, activation and paid conversion.  
Filestack is a developer-focused file infrastructure platform. The priority there is improving lead quality  
and conversion, and building a repeatable growth system across developer self-service and enterprise  
sales motions.  
  
The role is leadership-first: defining where each brand competes, which products and segments deserve  
investment, and how Product Marketing, Growth, SEO/GEO/AEO, Content, Lifecycle, Paid Acquisition  
and Analytics work toward shared outcomes. With a lean team, the ideal candidate is also highly  
proficient with AI tools and AI agents, using them to scale content, campaigns, analysis and reporting,  
and can step into hands-on execution when it matters.  
  
This leader works closely with executive leadership, Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, and  
Customer Success across both brands.  
  
What You'll Own  
Marketing Vision and Portfolio Strategy

* Define the marketing vision, annual plan, quarterly roadmap and budget for APILayer and Filestack, balancing shared priorities with each brand's distinct needs.
* Identify the markets, segments, use cases, products and channels with the strongest growth potential, and decide where each brand should compete.
* Translate company goals into measurable targets for traffic, signups, activation, qualified pipeline, new revenue, expansion and retention.
* Make informed trade-offs across acquisition, product marketing, lifecycle, organic growth, paid media, content, partnerships and brand.
* Allocate budget and team capacity by strategic importance, expected return and performance evidence.

Team Leadership and Operating Model

* Lead, coach and develop a lean multidisciplinary team, with clear roles, ownership, expectations and career development.
* Design the team structure and decide where hiring, agencies, contractors or AI-driven workflows close capability gaps.
* Oversee agencies (including the Filestack SEO agency), contractors and vendors so external resources deliver measurable value.
* Establish annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly planning rhythms, with clear owners, dependencies and delivery tracking.
* Build a culture of accountability, analytical decision-making, experimentation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure marketing operations, documentation and institutional knowledge support continuity and scale.

AI-Powered Marketing

* Use AI tools and AI agents to scale content, SEO, lifecycle campaigns, research, analysis and reporting with a lean team.
* Design and run agent-based workflows that automate repeatable marketing work, with clear quality controls.
* Lead the team's adoption of AI, setting standards for where it is used and how output is reviewed.
* Grow visibility in AI search and answer engines (GEO/AEO) alongside traditional search.

Awareness, SEO, GEO and Content

* Make awareness and top-of-funnel growth the first priority for APILayer: grow brand visibility and qualified traffic across its website network through SEO, AI search, content, PPC and brand programs.
* Lead Filestack organic growth across traditional search, AI search, developer communities, technical content, integrations and comparison journeys.
* Guide development of developer-facing assets such as guides, tutorials, solution pages, integration content, benchmarks and migration resources.
* Improve visibility and conversion from discovery to documentation, signup, first implementation and purchase.

Demand Generation and Enterprise Growth

* Own integrated acquisition across SEO, paid search, content, email, lifecycle, partnerships, re-targeting and developer channels.
* Build Filestack enterprise programs with Sales that improve account quality, meeting conversion, opportunity creation and pipeline.
* Run structured tests across ICP, segmentation, messaging, landing pages, offers, forms, keywords and outreach sequences.
* Prioritize qualified demand and revenue contribution over raw lead volume.

Positioning, Product Marketing and Go-to-Market

* Set positioning, target audiences, category narratives and competitive differentiation for both brands and their priority products.
* Ensure each priority API and Filestack segment has a clear ICP, value proposition, use-case strategy and go-to-market plan.
* Translate technical capabilities into customer value (for Filestack: uploads, transformations, delivery, security, reliability and time to market).
* Own launches, migrations and major product updates with Product, from narrative and landing pages to enablement and post-launch measurement.
* Develop battlecards, comparison pages, customer stories and segment-specific proof points.
* Funnel, Lifecycle and Customer Growth
* Monitor funnel health on every APILayer website, from visit to signup, activation and paid, so a drop on any site is caught and fixed quickly.
* Co-own the Filestack visitor-to-signup-to-activation-to-paid journey with the PM and fix the highest-impact leaks.
* Build onboarding, nurture, upgrade, expansion, retention, renewal-support and win-back programs.
* Partner with Product, Engineering and Customer Success to improve documentation, onboarding, activation, adoption and expansion.
* Run a disciplined experimentation roadmap with clear hypotheses, success thresholds and documented learnings.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Act as the senior marketing partner to executive leadership, aligning marketing with company strategy and financial objectives.
* Work with Product Managers so roadmaps, launches, positioning, pricing, packaging and growth priorities stay aligned.
* Create clear decision-making and escalation paths, resolve conflicting priorities and remove execution blockers.

Performance Management and Executive Reporting

* Define the performance framework: revenue, traffic, signups, activation, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, paid conversion, CAC, CPL, churn, net retention, expansion and attribution.
* Maintain decision-ready dashboards at brand, portfolio and individual-API level, so averages do not hide differences between products.
* Deliver concise weekly and monthly reporting, and lead monthly and quarterly business reviews covering performance, risks, resource needs and corrective actions.
* Use customer research, competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, cohort data and channel economics to guide investment.

  
Required Experience

* 12+ years of progressive marketing experience in B2B SaaS companies, ideally in APIs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data products or technical software.
* Very strong proficiency in AI, including hands-on use of AI agents and AI tools to run marketing at scale: content production, SEO/GEO, campaign and lifecycle automation, research, analysis and reporting. Able to show concrete workflows or agents you have built or deployed, and the results they delivered.

Also required

* At least 5 years leading marketing teams or a full marketing function, including managers or senior individual contributors across multiple disciplines.
* Experience managing a portfolio of products, brands or business units with different growth profiles and investment needs.
* Demonstrated ownership of strategy, budget, pipeline, revenue contribution, customer acquisition, retention and executive reporting.
* Proven leadership across product marketing, demand generation, growth, lifecycle, SEO/content, paid acquisition, marketing operations and analytics.
* A track record of growing organic and brand-driven traffic at scale, ideally across multiple websites, products or brands.
* Experience building enterprise demand with Sales while supporting a developer self-service motion.
* Recent hands-on experience building and running campaigns, lifecycle programs and experiments yourself, not only through a team or agency.
* Strong people-management skills: organizational design, hiring, coaching, delegation and performance expectations.
* Strong analytical fluency with GA4, Google Search Console, GTM, CRM reporting, marketing automation, attribution and funnel/cohort analysis across multiple sites.
* Solid grasp of SaaS metrics: activation, conversion, CAC, churn, net retention, LTV and portfolio- level resource allocation.
* Enough technical fluency to read documentation, understand API and developer products, and hold credible discussions with Product and Engineering.
* Excellent executive communication, prioritization, stakeholder management and change- management skills.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* Able to work during US business hours.

Strong Plus

* Leadership experience at an API, developer-first or file/media infrastructure company, such as RapidAPI, Abstract API, Postman, Algolia, Cloudinary, Uploadcare or Transloadit.
* Experience improving developer activation and enterprise pipeline within the same product-led business.
* Experience leading distributed or international teams and coordinating internal specialists, agencies and contractors.
* Experience with platform migrations, portfolio consolidation, domain/SEO transitions, pricing and packaging changes, or cross-sell programs.
* Experience taking over an established marketing organization or brand on a compressed timeline, providing continuity during a leadership transition.

Leadership Profile

* Sets a clear direction across two brands and gives the team the context and authority to execute.
* Acts as an owner: sets priorities independently, makes trade-offs and delivers results.
* Moves comfortably between executive strategy and hands-on execution.
* Delegates effectively and develops specialists, while keeping accountability for outcomes and quality.
* AI-first by default: uses AI tools and agents to multiply the output of a lean team.
* Builds alignment across functions and communicates clearly with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.
* Combines strategic perspective, commercial accountability, technical curiosity and operational discipline.
* Able to start in early December 2026 to overlap with the outgoing Head of Marketing.

Description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.
  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.
  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.
  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.
  
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred
* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

Title: Manager Marketing and Communications
Description:

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Middle East & Africa is seeking an accomplished **Group Procurement Director** to lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive, group-wide strategic procurement function across our portfolio of operating hotels.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a commercially driven professional capable of transforming a decentralized purchasing environment into a coordinated, efficient, and value-generating procurement organization.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of establishing procurement strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and sourcing capabilities across complex organizations comprising multiple operating entities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Procurement Strategy & Organization**

* Design and implement a group-wide procurement strategy, operating model, and governance framework.
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, approval authorities, and compliance standards across the hotel portfolio.
* Define the optimal balance between centralized strategic sourcing and decentralized operational purchasing.

**2. Group Synergies & Value Creation**

* Identify and capture procurement synergies, economies of scale, and consolidation opportunities across multiple properties and geographies.
* Develop category management strategies, group purchasing agreements, and preferred supplier frameworks.
* Deliver measurable cost efficiencies while maintaining operational quality, service standards, and business continuity.

**3. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.
* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and develop regional and international sourcing opportunities.
* Implement robust supplier evaluation, risk management, and contractual governance processes.

**4. Performance, Technology & Transformation**

* Introduce procurement performance indicators, spend analytics, reporting dashboards, and savings measurement methodologies.
* Drive procurement digitalization, including appropriate e-procurement platforms and purchasing systems.
* Build a culture of procurement excellence, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**

* Partner closely with hotel General Managers, Finance Directors, operational teams, and corporate leadership.
* Engage constructively with hotel owners and stakeholders to align procurement initiatives with property-level requirements and ownership structures.
* Build and lead a high-performing procurement organization capable of supporting a geographically diversified portfolio.

**The ideal candidate:**

* 15+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership responsibilities in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and scaling centralized or coordinated procurement functions across large, decentralized, multi-entity organizations.
* Strong experience in category management, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, procurement governance, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to generate measurable financial benefits through procurement consolidation and organizational transformation.
* Experience in hospitality, retail, food & beverage, travel retail, or other multi-site service industries. Hospitality experience is advantageous but not essential.
* Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, analytical capabilities, and technology orientation.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and change-management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across independently managed operating entities.
* Preferably currently based in the UAE or wider GCC, with relevant regional market knowledge and supplier networks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional certifications are advantageous.

**Why join us?**

This position offers the opportunity to **build and shape a strategic procurement function at group level**, with direct influence on operational performance, profitability, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Chief Performance Officer, the Group Procurement Director will play a central role in strengthening the operational excellence and competitiveness of Millennium & Copthorne Hotels across the Middle East and Africa.

We welcome applications from accomplished procurement leaders across industries who have demonstrated the ability to create scalable, high-performing procurement organizations.

**If you have built procurement capabilities across complex, multi-site businesses and are ready to make a tangible impact at regional level, we would welcome your interest.**
