Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Location - Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah**

**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

Title: Global Travel Retail Executive
Description:
**Job Description: Global Travel Retail (GTR) Executive**

**Company:** Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI)  
**Department:** Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE – Head Office  
**Reporting to:** Director – Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirements:** Based on business needs.

**Position Overview:**

Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI) is seeking a proactive, commercially driven Travel Retail Executive to support the continued expansion and management of its Global Travel Retail business.

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.
* Act as the main coordination point for account-related inquiries, operational requirements, and commercial follow-ups.
* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.
* Develop and maintain monthly sales dashboards tracking actual performance against forecasts and targets.
* Identify sales trends, underperforming SKUs, and opportunities to improve product assortment and retail performance.
* Monitor retail selling prices, competitive positioning, and relevant market developments across airports.
* Coordinate with retail partners to establish consistent sales reporting schedules and ensure timely receipt of accurate data.
* Prepare monthly account performance reviews with key findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions.

**Planning, Inventory & Order Management:**

* Coordinate with duty-free operators to obtain regular stock reports and monitor inventory levels by SKU and retail location.
* Work closely with GTI's Demand Planning, Production, and Logistics teams to develop rolling sales forecasts and replenishment requirements.
* Proactively identify potential out-of-stock situations and recommend timely replenishment orders.
* Coordinate purchase orders from confirmation through production, shipment, delivery, and receipt.
* Monitor stock coverage, inventory ageing, and slow-moving products, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Maintain visibility over lead times, shipment schedules, and operational constraints affecting product availability.

**New Listings & Business Expansion:**

* Support the onboarding of new duty-free accounts and airport listings with international operators, including Avolta, Heinemann, OSPREE, CREOL, and other partners.
* Coordinate the administrative and operational requirements for new product listings, including SKU documentation, product specifications, pricing submissions, and required commercial information.
* Maintain a central pipeline tracker for upcoming airport listings, launches, and account development projects.
* Coordinate internally with Marketing, Finance, Legal, Production, and Logistics to ensure timely completion of listing requirements.
* Follow up with partners on launch schedules, initial purchase orders, stock delivery, and retail readiness.
* Support the preparation of commercial presentations, account proposals, and business development materials.

**Marketing & Retail Execution:**

* Coordinate with GTI's Marketing team and duty-free operators to implement agreed trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and brand visibility initiatives.
* Monitor the installation and maintenance of branded displays, gondolas, point-of-sale materials (POSM), and other merchandising assets.
* Ensure the agreed product assortment, shelf placement, and brand visibility standards are maintained across retail locations.
* Coordinate promotional calendars, in-store activations, and seasonal commercial initiatives with retail partners.
* Monitor the execution of marketing commitments, including display rentals, promotional placements, and other agreed investments.
* Gather photographic evidence, retail feedback, and execution reports to assess the effectiveness of marketing activities.

**Brand Ambassador & Agency Coordination:**

* Coordinate with appointed Brand Ambassador and merchandising agencies supporting GTI's Travel Retail operations.
* Monitor staffing deployment, attendance, retail coverage, and compliance with agreed service requirements.
* Collect and review Brand Ambassador sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate product training, promotional briefs, and brand-related communication in collaboration with Marketing.
* Track agency performance against agreed KPIs and escalate execution gaps where necessary.
* Support the evaluation of promotional activities and Brand Ambassador effectiveness in driving incremental sales.

**Commercial Administration & Financial Coordination:**

* Maintain accurate records of commercial agreements, pricing structures, listing fees, promotional budgets, and account-specific financial commitments.
* Coordinate with Finance on sales reconciliations, invoicing, payment follow-ups, and outstanding receivables.
* Support monthly reconciliation of consignment sales and inventory for accounts operating under consignment arrangements.
* Validate reported sales quantities, applicable commercial deductions, marketing fees, and settlement amounts against agreed commercial terms.
* Track approved trade marketing expenditure and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Highlight commercial discrepancies, unapproved changes, or potential financial exposure to management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

Performance will be assessed against a combination of commercial, operational, and execution-related indicators:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and growth across assigned Travel Retail accounts.
* **Product Availability:** Stock availability, stock coverage, and reduction of avoidable out-of-stock incidents.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Reliability of sales forecasts and replenishment recommendations.
* **Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission and accuracy of sales, stock, and account performance reports.
* **Listing Execution:** Timely completion of new airport listings, product launches, and associated operational milestones.
* **Retail Execution:** Compliance with agreed assortment, merchandising, display, and promotional requirements.
* **Agency Performance:** Brand Ambassador coverage, reporting compliance, and achievement of agreed performance objectives.
* **Financial Follow-Up:** Timely sales reconciliation, invoicing coordination, and resolution of outstanding payment issues.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, or a related field.

**Professional Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, previous experience in Travel Retail, Duty Free, FMCG, or consumer goods distribution is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with international retail operators, distributors, or multi-market accounts would be an advantage.
* Practical exposure to sales forecasting, inventory management, order processing, and commercial reporting.
* Experience coordinating promotional activities, merchandising programs, or third-party agencies is desirable.

**Technical Skills:**

### **An overview of this role**

As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. You'll turn GitLab's safety and resilience strategies into practical programs that work across countries, both day to day and when a crisis disrupts how people work.

### **What you’ll do**

* Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.
* Identify and meet each country's legal safety obligations with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, and local vendors. Track changes in the law and keep records of required appointments, assessments, committees, training, and medical surveillance. Manage vendor agreements and keep safety and resilience services within budget.
* Coordinate required consultation with works councils and team members before GitLab makes a decision or contacts affected team members outside the consultation process. Prepare consultation materials, participate in health and safety committees where they exist, and retain the consent, hearing, and anonymized reporting records each jurisdiction requires.
* Run the workplace violence prevention program. Coordinate the threat management team, train managers, and keep case records and legally required local plans up to date.
* Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.
* Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.
* Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.
* Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.

### **What you’ll bring**

* Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.
* Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.
* Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.
* Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
* Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.

Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

**You'll Be Responsible For:**

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.

Title: Head of Pre-Sales
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182470

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Head of Pre-Sales at Al-Futtaim Technologies is responsible for leading the regional Pre-Sales function across the UAE, KSA, and Qatar. This position ensures the governance, quality, and final sign-off of technical solutions, estimates, cost sheets, and bid submissions. The role is pivotal in qualifying opportunities, ensuring technical compliance, deliverability, cost competitiveness, and successful handover to delivery teams. The Head of Pre-Sales also manages the pre-sales operating model, engagement frameworks, and feedback loops to improve bid speed, solution differentiation, and customer conversion rates while safeguarding gross margin.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Leadership, Strategy and Capacity**

  
  

* Lead the regional Pre-Sales function and establish a high-performance, customer-centric and control-focused culture with clear LOB ownership, workload allocation, succession and capability plans.
* Develop and execute the Product and Services Strategy across supported domains, aligned with market priorities, partnership strengths, recurring-revenue opportunities and AFT delivery capability.
* Maintain a capacity plan by geography and LOB; prioritize strategic bids; identify skill gaps; and recommend hiring, cross-utilization, automation or approved external support.
* Ensure senior pre-sales governance remains independent enough to challenge scope, pricing, and risk while collaborating closely with Sales.
  

  

#### **Opportunity Qualification and Bid Governance**

  
  

* Implement a documented bid/no-bid and Go/No-Go process covering strategic fit, probability, client budget, technical feasibility, compliance, delivery capacity, cash/credit exposure, contract risk, vendor readiness, and expected margin.
* Assign a bid owner, independent reviewer, RACI, timeline, and dependency plan at kickoff; front-load site surveys, portal access, RFIs, vendor engagement, and approvals.
* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.
* Approve the estimate only when unresolved items are quantified, allocated to a named owner and covered through contingency, qualification, variation entitlement or management-approved risk acceptance.
  

  

#### **Commercial Competitiveness and Vendor/OEM Management**

  
  

* Create a competitive solution and pricing strategy from the first submission, normally including a fully compliant base option and an AFT-designed value-engineered alternative where the tender permits.
* Build and manage principal, OEM, distributor and specialist-partner relationships; secure registrations, certifications, rebates, project discounts, price validity, lead-time commitments, and technical support early in the cycle.
  

  

#### **Proposal Quality and Submission Control**

  
  

* Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, persuasive and aligned with RFP format, technical and commercial separation, required certificates, datasheets, drawings, compliance matrices and submission instructions.
* Enforce a two-level review for major bids: preparer/LOB review followed by independent cross-check and Head of Pre-Sales sign-off.
* Ensure timely submission of all tenders across UAE, KSA and Qatar, with documented exceptions and recovery actions.
  

  

#### **Service, AMC and Casual-Job Costing**

  
  

* Ensure Pre-Sales is the single point of accountability for service-proposal solution design, BOQ, vendor quotations and costing completeness before customer submission.
* Use Finance-approved loaded man-hour rates and validate service frequency, response/resolution commitments, standby/on-call requirements, vehicles, tools, spares, subcontract support, escalation, warranty overlap and contract duration.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Technical proficiency in solution architecture across ICT, ELV, and integrated digital systems.
* Advanced estimate review and cost modeling capabilities including Excel, CRM, and analytics platforms.
* Strategic leadership and decision-making skills with a focus on competitiveness and risk management.
* Strong negotiation, executive presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Controls/Automation or a relevant discipline.
* MBA, Master's degree, chartered/professional engineering credential or recognized commercial/estimating qualification is preferred.
* 12-15 years of progressive experience in ICT, ELV/SSLV, BMS, AV, digital or systems-integration pre-sales, including significant regional leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-country tendering and major, multi-system bids in UAE and/or KSA; experience in Qatar is advantageous.
  

  

About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

Title: Director of Sales
Description:
**Position:** Director of Sales

**About Cedarhurst:**

Cedarhurst Senior Living is a leading provider of senior living communities, dedicated to enriching the lives of residents through exceptional care and personalized services. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, Cedarhurst creates vibrant environments where seniors can thrive and enjoy a fulfilling lifestyle.

**Why Work for Cedarhurst:**

* At Cedarhurst, our core values guide how we work together and how we care for those we serve. We expect every team member to be passionate, trustworthy, empathetic, positive, respectful, and approachable. Being part of Cedarhurst means making a meaningful difference every day.
* We believe our team is our greatest strength. That’s why we invest in comprehensive training, as well as opportunities for both personal and professional growth. We’re committed to promoting from within and supporting team members who want to build their careers with us.
* Cedarhurst offers a competitive benefits package, including medical insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan with company match (after one year of service) for eligible employees.
* At Cedarhurst, we go beyond the standard benefits program to recognize and support our team. Along with comprehensive benefits, we offer GROW Points—a unique rewards system that celebrates your hard work and dedication. You’ll also enjoy perks like exclusive Skechers shoe discounts, early paycheck access, and more!

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Sales is responsible for driving occupancy and revenue growth by leading the full sales process from inquiry through move-in, while ensuring the community meets and exceeds established goals. This role develops and executes a strategic sales plan, cultivates strong referral networks, and builds lasting relationships with prospective residents, families, and professional partners. The Director of Sales serves as the community’s primary representative for inquiries and outreach, partners with the Executive Director and regional sales leaders to implement creative strategies, and coaches staff to maximize referral opportunities. By combining strategic planning, relationship management, and a solutions-focused approach, the Director of Sales ensures a positive experience for prospects and contributes to the overall success of the community.

**Essential Functions:**

*The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.*

* Prioritize and execute revenue-generating sales activities that directly support community growth and operational success.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for phone inquiries and walk-in visitors, effectively converting leads into move-ins to drive occupancy.
* Develop and maintain robust outreach strategies to expand professional referral networks and generate qualified leads.
* Conduct comprehensive discovery with prospective residents and families to identify needs and present tailored solutions, including appropriate placement in Assisted Living or Memory Care.
* Implement timely and consistent follow-up activities to nurture trust, build long-term relationships, and move prospects through the decision-making process.
* Establish and cultivate strong partnerships with local businesses, healthcare providers, and senior resources, leveraging these relationships for both referral generation and added value for prospects and families.
* Accurately document and track all sales activities in the designated CRM/database, ensuring compliance with company standards and providing visibility to leadership.
* Partner with the Executive Director and regional sales teams to design and implement innovative sales strategies and community outreach programs that align with organizational goals.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director to coach and empower staff in generating referrals, ensuring inquiries are appropriately managed and maximized.
* Facilitate coaching sessions with staff to identify and implement strategic sales approaches for prospects, enhancing conversion rates and community reputation.
* Support and model effective communication practices between staff and families, ensuring residents’ physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing are consistently addressed.
* Demonstrate collaboration, initiative, and leadership in managing conflict resolution, fostering positive relationships among residents, families, staff, and community partners.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.*

* Bachelor’s Degree strongly preferred
* Two or more years of successful sales experience (2-5 years preferred), with prior experience in senior living strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated sales closing skills with a consistent record of high occupancy results.
* CPR or BLS certification preferred.
* Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

**Working Conditions:**

*As part of The Dover Company’s commitment to providing outstanding care and support, the company ensures that staff work under conditions that prioritize safety, collaboration, and professional growth. The conditions listed below define the experience of working at Cedarhurst and The Dover Companies.*

* This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
* This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
* Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
* This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
* Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.*

*Cedarhurst considers the health and safety of its residents, family members, and team members as its highest priorities. All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, participation in required health assessments (such as TB testing or physical evaluations), and the use of designated personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by company policy and applicable law.*

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**
------------

Chorus Innovations is a fast-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus' platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world-class health technology so they can thrive.

Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research.

### **About the Role**

Reporting to the CEO, the **Head of Sales** is responsible for owning and driving Chorus's new-logo revenue and national sales execution. This role is designed for a senior, hands-on sales leader who is actively involved in shaping deals, supporting sellers, and refining how Chorus sells — not just managing outcomes at a distance.

This role leads a small but growing national team of Account Executives, directly manages the SVP of Growth (responsible for expansion within existing accounts), and—depending on experience—may also oversee Marketing. The Head of Sales is expected to work closely with sellers day-to-day, join key customer conversations, and actively support deal strategy as the team scales.

This is a hands-on, senior operator role for a healthcare sales leader who can step in immediately, open doors, actively shape and support deals, bring structure and discipline to the sales process, and help Chorus scale in a product-led, repeatable way.

**Customer Focus**

Chorus serves a mix of public and private healthcare and human services organizations, including:

* State and County Departments of Mental Health
* Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs)
* Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs)
* Community mental health providers and related agencies

  

The Head of Sales will be comfortable selling into complex healthcare environments with long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and existing technology ecosystems.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Revenue & Sales Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and scale a national team of Account Executives
* Work directly with sellers on active opportunities, including discovery, positioning, deal strategy, and executive conversations
* Drive consistent execution across regions while maintaining national coverage
* Establish and enforce clear expectations for pipeline management, deal progression, and forecasting
* Personally engage in complex, strategic, or high-impact deals as a player–coach, not just an escalated approver
* Establish and maintain clear sales metrics, forecasting discipline, and visibility into pipeline health to support decision-making and growth.

  

**Go-To-Market & Sales Execution**

* Bring clarity and discipline to how Chorus sells its defined product lines
* Emphasize productized, repeatable sales motions that support scalable licensing revenue
* Guide the team toward opportunities that balance customer needs with delivery, implementation, and long-term scalability
* Help position Chorus effectively within customers' existing healthcare technology ecosystems
* Ensure deals are well-framed, well-scoped, and positioned for long-term success

  

**Executive Selling & Market Presence**

* Leverage an existing network of healthcare, behavioral health, and public-sector relationships
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, system leaders, and decision-makers
* Represent Chorus at industry events, conferences, and executive forums
* Act as a senior closer and ambassador for Chorus's value proposition in the market

  

**Marketing & Growth Leadership**

* Partner closely with the SVP of Growth to ensure strong coordination between new-logo sales and account expansion
* Depending on experience, directly oversee Marketing and help grow a small, evolving team
* Strengthen lead generation, demand creation, and sales–marketing alignment
* Ensure marketing efforts are tightly connected to sales priorities and conversion goals

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Product, Delivery, and Customer Success to align sales strategy with product capabilities
* Create strong feedback loops from the field to inform product positioning, packaging, and prioritization
* Balance growth ambition with operational discipline and long-term customer success

### **Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive revenue or sales leadership experience in healthcare technology, health IT, or SaaS
* Proven success leading sales teams through periods of growth and change, including building structure while actively selling
* Experience selling into both public and private healthcare organizations
* Track record of driving licensing-based or recurring revenue growth

**Healthcare Credibility**

* Deep familiarity with healthcare buying environments and long sales cycles
* Comfortable navigating organizations with existing technology platforms and vendors
* Experience positioning solutions alongside EHRs and other healthcare systems
* A strong rolodex of relevant healthcare, behavioral health, or public-sector contacts is a significant advantage

**Leadership Style & Skill****s**

* A "hit-the-ground-running" leader who can improve execution quickly
* Brings structure, clarity, and accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, and judgment
* Comfortable balancing strategic leadership with frequent, hands-on involvement in active deals and sales execution
* High integrity, collaborative mindset, and strong ownership mentality

The base salary offered is determined by several factors, including but not limited to the applicant's qualifications, relevant experience, specific skills, level of education, certifications or professional licenses, and geographic location where the job will be performed. As B2B Sales Manager, KSA, you will own Flow's corporate housing and relocation business across the Kingdom. You will be the senior commercial relationship for HR leaders, global mobility teams, and procurement at the largest employers in Saudi Arabia — from giga-projects and government-linked entities to multinationals, consulting firms, and fast-scaling local champions bringing talent into the country. **Pipeline & New Business Development:**

* Identify, prioritize, and pursue target accounts across KSA — including giga-projects, government and semi-government entities, multinationals, consulting and professional services firms, and fast-growing local employers with significant mobility needs.

**Account Management & Renewals:**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for corporate accounts post-signature, ensuring smooth onboarding and a seamless resident experience for relocated employees.
* Drive renewals, expansions, and cross-sell across Flow's MENA footprint as new communities come online.
* Build deep, trust-based relationships with HR, global mobility, procurement, and executive sponsors at key accounts.

**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring:**

* Structure multi-unit, multi-year corporate housing agreements that balance occupancy, ADR, and long-term account value.
* Partner with finance and revenue management to price competitively while protecting margin.
* Work with legal on master service agreements, preferred supplier arrangements, and bespoke contract terms required by enterprise customers.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with property leadership and operations to ensure corporate residents receive the experience promised in the sales process.
* Work closely with Marketing on B2B campaigns, account-based marketing, sector positioning, and industry events.

**Market Intelligence:**

* Maintain a clear view of the KSA corporate housing landscape — competitor offerings, pricing, inventory, and how mobility budgets are evolving as Vision 2030 reshapes the market.

### **Ideal Background**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a meaningful portion selling into HR, global mobility, procurement, or C-suite buyers at large enterprises.

Headquartered in the United States, Flow was established in 2021 with a $350 million investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the largest individual investment in the venture capital firm's history.

Title: Head of Mid-Market Sales

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

* Recruit, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of sellers focused on prospecting, closing, and growing business with advertisers ; establish an agile, high-accountability sales culture tailored to the mid-market segment.

* Equip the sales team to translate Netflix’s unique value—premium content, deep viewer engagement, and cultural relevance—into compelling, data-backed commercial narratives.
* Collaborate with Operations, Measurement, Tech, and Marketing teams to eliminate operational friction, optimize campaign delivery, and enhance advertiser ROI.

* 15+ years of experience in digital media
* 10+ years of experience in sales or marketing within Mid-Market segment
* 6+ years of experience as a manager

* Demonstrated experience using data to craft strategy
* Experience driving revenue growth with both emerging opportunities and established partnerships
* Experience building a new team, segment, or function from scratch, including first hires, first playbook, and first revenue target
* Track record of owning a revenue target and forecast, and running a team on pipeline, conversion, and rep productivity metrics
* Knowledge of advertising technology and data/performance measurement trends
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with an emphasis on translating insights, product information, and data into client value
* Experience building relationships with top marketing decision-makers at brands and agencies
* Deep understanding of the industry landscape
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Understanding of MMM, MTA, Sales and Conversion Lift, and a point of view on the evolution of measurement for modern marketing
* Demonstrated understanding of brand best practices and brand measurement
* Proven knowledge of signal, value, and performance marketing

Head of After Sales (3719285)
Description:
**Head of After Sales, North America**

**Location**
: Charlotte, NC preferred. Remote within the United States considered for the right profile.

**Travel**
: Regular travel across the United States; occasional international travel.

**Team**
: Approximately 9 people (first-level technical support and second-level field technicians, plus external service partners.

**Employment**
: Full-time, permanent.

**About the Client**

Our client is an international group and a leading manufacturer of professional coffee machines and automated food and beverage equipment for the out-of-home market, with a strong focus on super-automatic espresso technology.

Its North American business is experiencing double-digit growth and has established a new US subsidiary. The company is investing in its people, infrastructure and service capabilities, offering the opportunity to join a lean, entrepreneurial organization with close collaboration and direct exposure to its European headquarters.

**Position Overview**

The company is entering a new phase of development in North America and is looking for a
**Head of After Sales to lead, consolidate and further develop its entire aftermarket organization.**

Reporting to the North American leadership, this person will have end-to-end responsibility for the After Sales function, bringing together first-level technical support, second-level field service and the broader aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry and service solutions.

This is a genuine
**build-and-transform opportunity**
, rather than a role focused on maintaining an established structure. The successful candidate will be expected to bring leadership, structure and accountability to the organization, while remaining sufficiently hands-on to understand operational challenges, support the team and engage directly in critical customer situations.

The ultimate objective is to develop a high-performing service organization that delivers an outstanding customer experience while establishing After Sales as a stronger and increasingly profitable contributor to the North American business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Service Organization & Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of employees across first-level technical support (phone and email troubleshooting) and second-level field technicians/trainers throughout North America.
* Review, design, and lead the transformation of the service organization, establishing clear responsibilities, support levels, escalation paths, operating procedures and performance KPIs.
* Establish effective coordination between remote technical support and field service/training, ensuring that resources are deployed efficiently and customer issues are resolved promptly.
* Plan and coordinate field service/training activities, technician schedules and customer visits to ensure effective geographical coverage and optimal use of resources.
* Build, develop, and manage a network of third-party field service providers (external) across North America.
* Identify organizational and resource requirements to support business growth, including planned additional hires in North America.

**2. Technical Support, Training & Product Expertise**

* Develop and implement structured technical training programs to strengthen the technical capabilities and independence of the internal service team.
* Oversee technical training and certification programs for customers' technicians and external service partners.
* Ensure effective knowledge transfer and consistent technical standards across the North American service network.
* Act as the primary interface with European headquarters, coordinating with Technical Support, R&D and Production on complex technical cases, recurring product issues and product improvements.
* Drive a systematic approach to troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and the resolution of recurring technical issues.
* Ensure that technical knowledge and field feedback are effectively shared with headquarters and translated into improvements in products, processes and customer support.

**3. Aftermarket Business Development & Profitability**

* Develop the North American aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry, maintenance solutions and service offerings.
* Develop and execute a strategy to increase aftermarket revenue, improve profitability and strengthen customer retention.
* Manage and develop relationships with national spare-parts distributors, supporting commercial policies, discount structures, product bundles and promotional programs.
* Identify opportunities to expand the penetration of accessories, service solutions and value-added offerings across the installed machine base.
* Work closely with headquarters to define the product and accessory portfolio, ensuring alignment with North American customer needs and market opportunities.
* Establish appropriate performance metrics and reporting to monitor aftermarket sales, margins, service performance and business development opportunities.
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Service and Marketing to develop an integrated approach to customer satisfaction, retention and revenue growth.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in After Sales, Technical Service or Field Service for capital equipment, of which at least 2 years leading technical teams (field and/or remote support).
* Proven track record of building, restructuring or significantly improving a service organization, including processes, team structures and escalation mechanisms.
* Solid technical understanding of electromechanical equipment that interacts with a product and requires precise calibration, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, calibration and ongoing maintenance (e.g. super-automatic espresso machines, traditional coffee machines, grinders, gelato machines, combi ovens).
* Demonstrated commercial acumen and experience developing aftermarket revenue streams, including spare parts, accessories, service agreements or maintenance programs.
* Experience managing distributors, channel partners and/or external service provider networks.
* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to translate strategy into operational execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with full professional proficiency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across North America. Valid driver's license and passport required.

**Preferred**

* Background in professional coffee equipment, ideally super-automatic machines, or in comparable food service equipment (ovens, fryers, gelato and soft-serve equipment).
* Previous experience working for an equipment manufacturer, distributor or national service organization within the foodservice industry.
* Familiarity with telemetry, connected equipment, CRM platforms, field service management systems, and Salesforce.
* Experience working with international headquarters, ideally within a European multinational organization.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed teams across North America.

**What We Are Looking For**

Beyond technical expertise and management experience, we are looking for an individual who combines a builder's mentality, strong leadership and commercial orientation. The ideal candidate:

* **Is a builder, not simply a manager**
  : enjoys creating structures, developing people and implementing processes, while remaining directly involved in operational matters when needed.
* **Takes ownership, proactively propose solutions, and makes decisions**
  : is comfortable setting priorities, establishing boundaries and making difficult decisions, including managing customer expectations when necessary.
* **Leads with accountability**
  : sets clear expectations, follows through on commitments and creates a culture of responsibility and performance.
* **Stays effective under pressure**
  : understands the urgency of equipment downtime in commercial environments and can support a team dealing with demanding customers and time-sensitive situations.
* **Develops people**
  : provides direction, coaching and constructive feedback, building a stronger and more independent technical organization.
* **Combines technical and commercial thinking**
  : understands that excellent service is not only about resolving technical issues, but also about protecting customer relationships and developing business opportunities.
* **Works across cultures and functions**
  : builds effective relationships with North American colleagues, external partners and European headquarters.

**Why Join**

This is an opportunity to take on a high-impact leadership position within an international manufacturer at a pivotal stage of its North American expansion. You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape and develop the entire After Sales organization across North America.
* Build a stronger service infrastructure, including internal capabilities and an external partner network.
* Take ownership of the aftermarket business and directly influence its growth and profitability.
* Work closely with North American leadership and European headquarters, with significant visibility and influence across the organization.
* Make a tangible impact on the company's customer experience, operational performance and long-term growth.

**If you are an entrepreneurial After Sales leader who enjoys building teams, improving service organizations and turning technical excellence into business performance, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.**

Title: Manager Supply Chain Operations and Services
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Our Group Procurement & Logistics team delivers strategic sourcing and integrated supply chain solutions that strengthen operational resilience, optimise value and enable sustainable business performance.

The **Manager Supply Chain Operations and Services** will lead and manage end-to-end Supply Chain Operations and Group-wide functional governance and performance management of logistics services. They will ensure reliable, compliant and cost-effective distribution center operations, supply continuity, inventory and working-capital efficiency, service performance, compliance and cost effectiveness across planning, replenishment, warehousing, distribution, transportation and trade compliance. The role will drive an integrated operating model through standardised processes, digital enablement, performance governance and continuous improvement, while developing the people and capabilities required to support current and future business needs.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead and manage the Supply Chain Operations and Services function by developing and implementing tactical plans, priorities and objectives for the area of accountability, ensuring delivery of departmental strategy and business objectives. Set performance expectations and oversee multidisciplinary teams covering planning, replenishment, inventory management, distribution centres, logistics, supplier performance and trade compliance to ensure effective operational execution.
* Direct end-to-end supply chain execution of Uniform Distribution Centers, the General Distribution Center, warehousing, transportation and associated logistics services , ensuring consistent operating standards, capacity planning, resource deployment, operational readiness, service quality, inventory accuracy and effective fulfilment across all relevant locations and customer channels.
* Lead freight, transportation and warehousing services supporting Emirates business requirements, including air, sea and road movements and third-party logistics providers. Optimize capacity, routing, consolidation, service levels and total logistics cost. Monitor freight-market, carrier-capacity, geopolitical and regulatory developments and translate material risks into sourcing input, contingency planning and network decisions.
* Maintain accountability for product availability, supply continuity and inventory performance by directing the team to establish robust demand forecasting, appropriate inventory policies, segmentation, safety-stock levels and replenishment parameters, and to control stock-outs, excess, slow-moving and obsolete inventory.
* Manage strategic logistics providers and outsourced service arrangements by establishing clear governance, service-level agreements, performance measures, reporting requirements and escalation protocols. Direct provider reviews, corrective actions, mobilisation and operational transitions in collaboration with Procurement and relevant business stakeholders.
* Provide leadership and governance for customs and trade-compliance activities, ensuring that responsible teams, customs brokers and logistics providers maintain appropriate controls over declarations, tariff classification, duties and taxes, records, permits and regulatory authorisations.
* Lead supply chain transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across warehouse operations, logistics network optimisation, regional distribution centres, systems implementation, process standardisation and new service solutions. Develop business cases, implementation plans and change management activities to support successful delivery, stakeholder adoption and measurable business benefits.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Hold an attested Bachelor's Degree or Masters degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement,Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, Business Administration/MBA, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in an experience in supply chain, logistics, distribution, warehousing or another complex operational environment, including significant management responsibility in a multi-country or matrix organisation.
* A recognised professional qualification in supply chain, logistics, procurement or operations management is preferred. Such as CIPS, CILT, CSCP or equivalent.
* Experience should cover several of the following: demand and supply planning, inventory management, distribution centers, international transportation, freight markets, warehousing, customs and trade compliance, strategic third-party logistics providers, outsourced control-tower operations and large-scale transformation.

Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.  
  
We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required
