Title: Warehouse Manager
Description:
### **Job Title:** **Warehouse Manager**

**Department:** Operations
  
**Location:** NEP Middle East – Dubai, UAE  
**Reports to:** Head of Operations MEA  
**Direct Reports:** Warehouse Assistants, Drivers, Freelancers (as needed)

### **Role Overview:**

As **Warehouse Manager** at NEP Middle East, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of the warehouse to ensure efficient, accurate, and safe handling of broadcast equipment and materials. You will manage the dispatch, receipt, storage, and return processes, while coordinating closely with the technical and production teams to support the delivery of high-profile events and productions.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Warehouse Operations & Coordination**

* Supervise daily warehouse activities including equipment check-in/check-out, inventory movements, and preparation for live projects.
* Ensure all incoming and outgoing equipment is accurately scanned, recorded, cleaned, and stored.
* Coordinate loading/unloading, packing, and shipment schedules with internal teams and logistics providers.

**Inventory & Asset Management**

* Oversee inventory control processes including tagging, barcode scanning, and regular cycle counts.
* Maintain accurate stock levels and ensure proper documentation using internal systems (e.g., HERO, ClearCo, etc.).
* Identify and report damaged or missing equipment; coordinate repairs or replacements as necessary.

**Team Supervision & Safety**

* Supervise and schedule the warehouse team, including freelancers and drivers.
* Enforce safety procedures and cleanliness standards within the warehouse.
* Provide guidance and hands-on support for technical packing and operational best practices.

**Cross-Department Collaboration**

* Work closely with operations, engineering, and production teams to ensure equipment readiness and availability for events.
* Support equipment requests for last-minute changes and on-site needs.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate documentation of equipment transfers, dispatch notes, delivery records, and internal forms.
* Provide weekly status reports to management, including inventory levels, issues, and recommendations.

### **Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of warehouse or logistics experience, with **previous experience in the broadcast industry being essential**.
* Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, inventory management systems, and broadcast equipment handling.
* Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and warehouse tracking tools.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.
* Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Proactive team player with strong leadership, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
* Physically fit and capable of performing manual handling tasks when required.

### **Why Join NEP Middle East?**

NEP is a global leader in live and broadcast production services. As part of our warehouse team, you’ll support some of the biggest and most dynamic productions in the region. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment and grow your operational leadership career.

Title: Warehouse Manager
Description:
**Job Title: Warehouse Manager**

**Location:** Newmarket, ON (on-site)

**Reports to:** Operations Manager

**Employment type:** Full-time, permanent

**Salary:** $90,000 to $125,000 per year, plus benefits

Summary

The Warehouse Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the end-to-end material flow across the organization, from receiving and inventory storage to production staging, finished goods management, and final shipping.

This position provides strategic and operational leadership to the warehouse, receiving, and shipping teams, ensuring inventory accuracy, efficient material handling, timely order fulfillment, and compliance with company policies and safety standards.

The successful candidate will drive continuous improvement initiatives, optimize inventory levels, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and establish clear responsibilities and accountability across warehouse operations. This role will also ensure effective coordination with Production, Sales, Purchasing, and other Norseman locations to maintain a cohesive flow of materials throughout the company's network using Microsoft Dynamics AX.

Key ResponsibilitiesWarehouse Operations & Leadership

* Manage, lead, and develop the warehouse, receiving, and shipping teams, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability.

* Coordinate daily warehouse priorities and allocate resources to meet operational requirements.

* Supervise, train, coach, and develop warehouse employees to improve performance, productivity, and operational effectiveness.

* Assign duties and monitor employee attendance, performance, and productivity.

* Conduct performance reviews and provide ongoing feedback and development opportunities.

* Participate in recruitment, hiring, onboarding, and training to maintain appropriate staffing levels.

* Establish and maintain standardized warehouse procedures and operating practices.

* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous improvement-oriented team environment.

* Step in to perform hands-on warehouse tasks occasionally, when needed to cover absences or unusual peaks in volume.

Health & Safety

* Carry out the duties of a supervisor under the Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA) for warehouse, receiving, and shipping staff, taking every precaution reasonable in the circumstances to protect workers.

* Ensure staff work in compliance with the OHSA, O. Reg. 851 (Industrial Establishments), and Norseman health and safety policies and procedures.

* Ensure staff use required personal protective equipment and are trained and authorized before operating lift trucks or other material handling equipment.

* Advise staff of known hazards and promptly correct unsafe acts and conditions.

* Report and investigate incidents and near misses, take part in workplace inspections, and support the Joint Health and Safety Committee.

Inventory Management & Control

* Oversee inventory management activities, ensuring accurate receiving and storage of materials and components, and shipping of finished goods.

* Ensure all physical inventory movements are accurately recorded and reflected in the AX system.

* Schedule and oversee cycle counts and physical inventories.

* Investigate inventory discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.

* Ensure received goods are checked against purchase orders in AX to verify quantities.

* Ensure proper identification, labeling, storage, and traceability of all inventory.

Receiving, Shipping & Transportation

* Oversee the scheduling and coordination of inbound and outbound freight carriers and courier services.

* Ensure incoming shipments are inspected and verified against purchase orders, and that damaged, missing, or discrepant goods are identified and reported.

* Determine the most effective and economical shipping methods for outgoing orders while maintaining accuracy and delivery commitments.

* Ensure outgoing orders are accurately picked, packed, labeled, and prepared for shipment.

* Oversee freight bookings and ensure all required shipping documentation is complete and accurate, including bills of lading, packing lists, export documents, and customs documentation.

* Liaise with carriers and transportation providers to resolve delivery issues and ensure timely shipments.

* Eliminate shipping and packing bottlenecks by improving processes, workflows, and resource allocation.

* Ensure the warehouse is adequately stocked with all required shipping, receiving, and packaging supplies.

* Ensure accurate shipping, receiving, and transportation records are maintained for reporting and tracking purposes.

Production & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Production to ensure raw materials are available to meet production schedules and operational demands.

* Coordinate the timely transfer of raw materials to production and the accurate return of finished goods into AX inventory.

* Liaise with Sales and Purchasing teams across all Norseman locations to coordinate material transfers, customer orders, and shipments.

* Maintain effective inventory and product control throughout the Norseman network using Microsoft Dynamics AX.

* Respond promptly to warehouse delivery issues and inquiries from Sales, Purchasing, and other departments.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve material shortages, inventory discrepancies, and shipping challenges.

* Ensure effective communication and coordination between Warehouse, Production, Purchasing, and Sales.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across receiving, inventory, and shipping workflows.

* Evaluate existing material handling processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.

* Apply continuous improvement methodologies to optimize warehouse layouts, storage practices, material flow, and inventory management.

* Maintain and improve warehouse organization by optimizing floor space, storage locations, and material handling practices.

* Develop and implement standardized procedures to improve consistency, accountability, and operational performance.

* Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure departmental effectiveness.

* Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks, unnecessary handling, delays, and process inefficiencies.

* Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and encourage employee involvement in problem-solving activities.

Qualifications & Experience

* Post-secondary education in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in warehouse, inventory, logistics, or distribution operations.

* Minimum 3 years of supervisory or management experience leading warehouse or supply chain teams.

* Strong knowledge of inventory control, warehouse management, shipping, receiving, and material handling processes.

* Experience with ERP/MRP systems; Microsoft Dynamics AX experience is a strong asset.

* Demonstrated experience with inventory reconciliation, cycle counting, and physical inventory management.

* Knowledge of domestic and international shipping procedures, freight coordination, and customs documentation.

* Proven experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.

* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, reporting, and KPI development.

* Working knowledge of the Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act and O. Reg. 851 (Industrial Establishments).

* Forklift experience and a valid forklift operator certification are considered an asset.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership, team management, and employee development skills.

* Excellent organizational, planning, and prioritization abilities.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

* Ability to develop and implement inventory control strategies.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Strong cross-functional collaboration and coordination abilities.

* Results-oriented mindset with a focus on accountability and continuous improvement.

* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

* High attention to detail and commitment to inventory and shipping accuracy.

Working Conditions

* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.

* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.

* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

* Set up, configure and deploy laptops, desktops, monitors and peripherals using modern device management tools
* Support Microsoft 365 and Teams users, including account setup, password resets and multi-factor authentication
* Support warehouse technology, including handheld RF scanners, label printers and mobile devices
* Carry out IT tasks for employee onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, equipment and access

* Excellent spoken and written communication in English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to users at all levels, from warehouse staff to executives

Title: Principal, Data Denters
Description:
**The role: from partnership to capacity in service**
Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you lead Echelon’s infrastructure partnerships and the business built on them: the partners Echelon builds with, the licensed business through which it designs, builds and operates to their standard, the customer programmes it delivers with them, the capability it develops alongside them and the investment cases behind new capacity. You decide where Echelon advises and where it builds with its partners, and you make each of those positions pay, working with the CRO’s account teams, Finance and Legal. You build the team from its first hires and lead it, and you set the model by which Echelon and its partners work together. In your first months you design that model with our lead partner: the joint business plan, the licensing and contracting structure, the staffing and liability behind each service, and the account plans for the first customers.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Run the partnership. Long-term relationships with the operators and suppliers whose designs and standards Echelon builds on, run with a shared plan and joint governance: the steering and pipeline reviews, the reporting and audit rights that secure Echelon’s share, and the performance targets that keep both sides committed; and the next partners that extend what Echelon can deliver.
* Turn the licence into a business. As local licensee of a lead partner’s designs, supply chain and operating procedures, an Echelon business that designs, builds and operates to that standard: the licence and royalty economics, the services Echelon sells and their pricing, the transfer of know-how and training, and the step from supporting the partner’s contracts to contracting with customers in its own right.
* Sell capacity. Large capacity programmes won with our partners, where you lead qualification, pricing and negotiation through to signature and structure each programme across its whole life, on terms that reward Echelon for the value it adds; and the next customers, from AI providers, hyperscalers and data centre operators to national programmes, government and large industrial enterprises that need modular and edge capacity.
* Build the investment case. The case for new capacity: what Echelon builds with its partners and what it leaves to others, and the business case behind it, from demand, power and the chip-generation ramp to capital structure, offtake and returns, built to hold up in front of customers, partners and investors.
* Hold the standard. Quality gates, operating procedures and liability lines, agreed with our partners, that bring every site Echelon touches up to the benchmark of the best operators, from build through to live operation.
* Build the team. The team you hire and lead, and the operating model around it: what Echelon does itself, what its partners do and what it buys, how each service is priced, staffed and insured, and the moment capability should come in-house, growing from engineering and build management into network, security and facility operations.

**Where we align -
**What you bring****

* Infrastructure record. You have taken data centre, cloud or power capacity from site and power through to energised and contracted, for an operator, a developer, a hyperscaler or the firms that advise them. What you have delivered counts for more than the years.
* Partnership leadership. You have led partnerships between companies of different size and culture, and kept both sides committed from signature to delivery.
* Commercial and financial depth. You have priced, negotiated and signed infrastructure deals yourself, and you read a project model: capital and operating cost, revenue share, offtake and returns hold no mystery for you.
* AI infrastructure depth. You understand what AI workloads change: power density, liquid cooling, the pace of chip generations, and their effect on design, cost and schedule.
* Team builder. You have hired and led teams of specialists, built a capability from its first hire and its first project, and set standards that hold as it scales.

**Strong advantage**

* Hyperscale and AI campuses. Exposure to campuses of 100 MW and above, from site and power to handover and operations.
* Licensed operating models. Experience of licensed or franchised models, where one company’s design and operating standard is delivered by another.
* Capital partners. Exposure to infrastructure investors, project finance or joint ventures.
* Modular and edge. Experience of selling or delivering modular, prefabricated or edge data centre solutions to enterprise or government buyers.

****Our values****

* Customer first. You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* Ownership mentality. You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator. You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder. You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others. You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

**The seat**

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, or Dubai
* Reports to: The Chief Executive Officer
* Language: English and Arabic, fluent
* Travel: Regular time with customers and on sites, and some with our partners’ teams in the United States.
* Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**How we work**
You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity. You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed. You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour. You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence and humility. You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy. You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness. Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organisation: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership. You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier. Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth. AI tools are part of how you plan, model and decide, and you understand from the inside what AI asks of the infrastructure that runs it.
* Where you are. A senior infrastructure developer and partnership leader who has sold capacity as well as built it, ready to build a team and a business, and at ease at the negotiating table, on site and in front of an investment committee.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

**Security Clearance**

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

Title: Principal-Platform Engineering
Description:
**Overview**
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
Principal
  
  
**Job Code**
**Grade**
E1
  
  
**Group**
Government Products
  
  
**Division**
Technology
  
  
**Department**
Technology Operations Center
  
  
**Unit**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
*The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective.*
To lead the end to end delivery of infrastructure and hosting projects from initial business request through production go-live and operational handover. The role acts as the primary technical delivery interface between product owners and Technology teams, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, hosting readiness is assessed, infrastructure dependencies are effectively coordinated, delivery risks and blockers are resolved, and solutions are technically ready for production in accordance with Elm’s architecture, cybersecurity, operational, and service management requirements.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities & Activities**
*This section describes the principal outputs required from the job.*
**Key Accountabilities**
**Key Activities**

* End-to-end delivery ownership
* Own hosting and infrastructure projects end to end, from initial request through to production go-live and handover to operations.
* Build and maintain the delivery plan: scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and go-live criteria.
* Act as the single point of contact for product owners on delivery status, blockers and timelines.
* Requirements gathering, readiness assessment and solution design
* Gather complete project information from product owners early, so work starts on a clear and agreed scope.
* Run the Product Readiness Assessment (PRA) and coordinate technical evaluation of hosting suitability.
* Translate the service design (draw.io architecture) into the required infrastructure components and service requests.
* Coordinate hosting cost estimation.
* Delivery service request (SR) management
* Raise, bundle and track all required delivery SRs through internal requests system.
* Ensure SRs are complete on first submission to avoid rework and SLA breaches.
* Follow up with implementation teams (compute, storage, network, security, platform) against internal OLAs.
* Go-live and operational handover
* Ensure go-live requirements, such as monitoring, backup, security controls and certificates, are in place before production launch.
* Hand over the service to operations teams with complete documentation and support arrangements.
* Run a post-go-live review and capture lessons learned.
* Governance and reporting
* Report on delivery status, risks and KPIs to the line manager.
* Escalate risks and issues that need a decision to senior management, with clear options and impact.
* Keep project details and documentation accurate and up to date.
* Customer and expectation management
* Validate the real urgency of each escalated request against business impact and evidence, and prioritise on facts rather than pressure.
* Handle late or incomplete submissions calmly: agree a realistic recovery plan, state the impact on timelines, and protect commitments already made to other projects.
* Keep working relationships constructive so that no dispute delays the company's delivery.
* Continuous improvement
* Identify recurring delays in the request flow and propose SR, form or process improvements.
* Run awareness sessions for product owners on how to request and prepare for hosting.
* Policies, Processes & Procedures
* Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment.
* Information Security
* Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS**
**Academic And Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification is preferred.

**Years And Nature Of Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure or Cloud environments, including 3+ years managing technical projects or service delivery.
* Working knowledge of data center and cloud hosting technologies, including virtualization using VMware, containers using OpenShift/Kubernetes, Red Hat Linux, networking, storage, and backup.
* Experience working with ITSM tools and processes, including Jira Service Management, SMAX, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Practical understanding of ITIL Request, Change, and Incident Management concepts.
* Ability to review solution architecture diagrams and translate them into infrastructure requirements and bills of materials.
* Exposure to public cloud environments such as GCP, Microsoft Azure, or AWS is preferred, particularly within Saudi sovereign or regulated environments.
* Familiarity with NCA cybersecurity controls, including ECC and CCC, and Saudi data residency requirements is preferred.
* Experience with hosting cost estimation and capacity planning is preferred.
* Strong ownership, stakeholder management, structured communication, problem-solving, process improvement, conflict resolution, and customer management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in both Arabic and English.
* Ability to maintain composure under pressure, manage exaggerated urgency objectively, and set realistic customer expectations without negatively impacting stakeholder relationships.

Title: eMBMS Engineer
Description:
**Grow with us**
----------------

**About this opportunity:**

The Back Office (BO) eMBMS Engineer supports the availability, performance, and service continuity of the LTE Broadcast / evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service platform used for mission-critical communications. The engineer owns second-line operational investigation and restoration of the Ericsson Mission Critical Broadcast Delivery Center (MC BDC) / Broadcast Core, and works across MCX application servers, LTE RAN, IP transport, cloud infrastructure, and network management teams to resolve end-to-end service issues.

This is an operations and service-assurance position, not sole ownership of RAN radio design, transport routing, MCX application logic, or cloud infrastructure. The engineer should understand those domains well enough to isolate faults, coordinate restoration, and validate outcomes.

**Join our Team**
-----------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Assurance and Incident Management**

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting LTE/EPC or mission-critical communications platforms in a telecom operations / back-office environment, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.
* Ability to trace control and user planes across MC AS, MC BDC, RAN, and transport; familiarity with Diameter, SCTP/M3AP, GTP-U/UDP, IP multicast, TCP/IP, routing, and time synchronization.

Reporting to the Global Operations Manager and working closely with the HR Director and Finance team, the role supports office coordination, employee administration, compliance tracking, travel arrangements and general operational activities.

We're looking for someone who is naturally proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused - someone who thinks ahead, spots potential issues early and takes the initiative to find practical solutions. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys making things happen, takes pride in being organised and can work independently, using good judgement and knowing when to seek guidance.

Ideally, candidates will already hold valid UAE residency sponsorship and have their own medical insurance cover.

* Liaise with office suppliers, building management and service providers as needed.
* Help organise team activities, celebrations and office events within agreed budgets.
* Act as a first point of contact for general office and administrative queries.

**General Administration & Operational Support**

* Assist with travel arrangements, bookings and other administrative requirements for the MENA team.
* Maintain organised electronic files, records, templates and trackers.
* Support the preparation and submission of routine business documentation, including registrations, supplier forms and tender administration.
* Help coordinate day-to-day operational tasks and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Global Operations Manager and wider team as required.

**Compliance & Renewal Administration**

* Maintain and update the Business Compliance & Renewals calendar, including company licences, registrations, visas and insurance renewals.
* Track important dates, organise supporting documentation and flag upcoming deadlines.
* Liaise with PROs, government service providers and internal colleagues to coordinate visa applications for new joiners, renewals, registrations and other required submissions, ensuring documentation is complete and deadlines are met.
* Ensure records and documentation are accurately maintained and filed.

**HR Administration**

* Support employee on-boarding and off-boarding, including local documentation, visas, insurance and practical arrangements.
* Use Shapes, our HR system, to coordinate and track onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring tasks are completed and records kept up to date.
* Coordinate regional medical insurance renewals, working closely with our brokers, HR and Finance teams to gather information, track renewal timelines, support policy administration and ensure continuity of cover.
* Act as a key point of contact for medical insurance brokers across the MENA region, supporting employee additions, removals, policy changes via the portal and day-to-day insurance queries.
* Liaise with HR, PRO providers and other partners to coordinate regional people administration.
* Maintain accurate and appropriately filed employee documentation and records.

**IT & Equipment Coordination**

* Coordinate IT setup and offboarding for new joiners and leavers, including laptops, equipment, system access and account deactivation.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of company equipment, including allocations, returns and replacements.
* Liaise with external IT support to coordinate equipment setup, resolve basic technical issues and ensure timely removal of access for leavers.
* Manage day-to-day IT support requests from the team, monitor outstanding tickets, follow up with IT support and escalating unresolved, urgent or recurring problems to the Global Operations Manager.

**Financial & Supplier Administration**

* Assist with processing and tracking supplier invoices, office expenses and payment requests.
* Maintain records of office expenditure, subscriptions and supplier costs.
* Obtain quotations and help coordinate supplier renewals and purchases.
* Ensure invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are provided to Finance.
* Flag discrepancies, unexpected charges or outstanding payments to the relevant team.

**Approach & Expectations**  
  
We're looking for someone who:

* *Is a natural problem solver* - approaches challenges with curiosity, common sense and a can-do attitude.
* *Thinks ahead and takes initiative* - anticipates what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
* *Is resourceful and solutions-focused* - looks for practical ways to resolve issues and brings suggestions when flagging problems.
* *Takes ownership* - follows tasks through to completion and doesn't let things fall between the cracks.
* *Is highly organised and detail-oriented* - stays on top of deadlines, records and competing priorities.
* *Is numerically confident and financially aware* - comfortable working with figures, understands the importance of budgets and costs, and has a good head for numbers.

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.
  + Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

  

**Quality and Safety**

* Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

  + Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections
  + Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections
  + Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  + Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

  

**Continuous Education**

* Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

  + Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)
  + Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  + Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions
  + Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.
  + The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

  

**Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems**

* Comply with all OSH and infection control policies, standards and procedures and cooperate with hospital management to comply those requirements

  + Notifying OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments, incident reports
  + Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  + Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  + Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
  + Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  + Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
  + Comply with Waste management procedures and policies. Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
  + Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
  + Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained

  

**Prevention and Control of Infection (PCI):**

* PCI is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC PCI Policy and Strategy in an effort to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.

  + The strictest hand hygiene, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times

  

**Qualification, Licensure, Experience and Special Skills:**

  

**Qualifications & licensure**

**Required:**

* Current license in country of origin with DHA license to practice in Dubai,U.A.E.
* Minimum 2 years’ experience of practice in Physical Medicine.

* Knowledge of the range and type of services available for aged/disabled person.

**Desired:** NA

Job Description

**Company:** NTT DATA

Position Overview

WebLogic
  
  
JDK/Java

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

***ELV Systems***

* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

* To be decided in interview

Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.
  
  
**Benefits For State Employees**
The state of South Carolina offers eligible employees generous benefits, including health and dental insurance; retirement and savings plan options; and paid vacation and sick leave. Eligible employees may enroll in health insurance, which includes prescription coverage and wellness benefits. Other available insurance benefits include dental, vision, term life insurance, long term disability and flexible spending accounts for health and child care expenses.
  
  
**Retirement Benefits**
State employees are also offered retirement plan options, including defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Additionally, eligible employees may elect to participate in the South Carolina Deferred Compensation Program, which is a voluntary, supplemental retirement savings plan offering 401(k) and 457 plan options.
  
  
**Workplace Benefits**
State employees may also be eligible for other benefits, including tuition assistance; holiday, annual and sick leave; and discounts on purchases, travel and more.
  
  
**Note:**
The benefits above are available to most state employees, with the exception of those in temporary positions. For these positions, contact the hiring agency to determine what benefits may be available.

Title: Chargé(e) princ de projet Bilingue, Exploitation, Payeurs-fournisseurs
Description:
**Description**
**Joignez-vous à notre équipe et ce que nous accomplirons ensemble**
À titre de chargé de projet principal ou de chargée de projet principale dans l’équipe de gestion de projet de l’exploitation payeur-fournisseur de TELUS Santé, vous serez responsable de la mise en œuvre complexe de systèmes de santé aux enjeux importants qui ont une incidence directe sur les clients de partout au Canada. Vous gérerez des projets à grande échelle dans la sphère de nos solutions de dossier médical électronique (DME), les initiatives de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie et/ou les déploiements de systèmes de pharmacie, en travaillant de manière indépendante pour piloter des projets à partir de l’analyse de rentabilité et d’une charte de projet jusqu’à la planification du projet, avec la flexibilité de développer votre propre encadrement. Votre leadership sera essentiel à la bonne exécution du projet, et vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative, axée sur les valeurs et engagée envers l’amélioration continue et l’excellence.
  
  
**Ce que vous ferez**

* Diriger des projets complexes dans notre portefeuille d’exploitation de payeurs-fournisseurs, qu’il s’agisse de solutions de DME, de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie ou de mise en œuvre de systèmes de Solutions en pharmacie. Travailler de façon autonome, tout en supervisant une équipe chargée d’élaborer des chartes de projet, en créant des analyses de rentabilité, en gérant des calendriers, des budgets, et des risques avec un minimum de supervision et en faisant appel à des recours hiérarchiques de façon stratégique, au besoin
* Faire des présentations à la haute direction avec clarté et assurance, qui traduisent de l’information complexe de par leur nature technique ou leur spécificité au projet en renseignements exploitables permettant de prendre des décisions, que ce soit pour le client ou les parties prenantes à l’interne
* Gérer des équipes de projet diversifiées et matricielles (analystes d’affaires, analystes de données, équipes cliniques, communications, fournisseurs) par la formation et le mentorat, en veillant à l’harmonisation entre les équipes internes de TELUS et les organisations clientes externes
* Promouvoir des méthodologies, des outils et des plateformes collaboratives de gestion de projet normalisés tout en favorisant l’excellence des livrables et le mentorat de membres fonctionnels de l’équipe
* Gérer et analyser des rapports complexes et veiller à ce que les mises en œuvre procurent des avantages tangibles à TELUS Santé et aux clients
* Rédiger des communications de projet très efficaces (infographies, notes de service, rapports à l’intention des cadres) adaptées à divers publics, allant des communications destinées aux clients aux mises à jour pour la haute direction ou le comité directeur

**Qualifications**
**Vous possédez**

* Bilinguisme (français et anglais)
* Un baccalauréat en administration, en informatique, en soins de santé ou dans une discipline connexe
* Certification de professionnel ou professionnelle en gestion de projet (PMP)
* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience progressive en gestion de projets avec une expertise démontrée dans l’application de principes, d’outils et de méthodologies de gestion de projet
* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience à diriger la mise en œuvre à grande échelle de systèmes de soins de santé complexes (solutions de DME, systèmes cliniques, plateformes de régime d’assurance maladie) tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, y compris la planification de la durabilité
* Aptitude avérée à travailler de manière autonome, avec un minimum de supervision, tout en gérant de nombreuses priorités concurrentes sous pression et en respectant des échéances fixes
* Maîtrise avancée de la mise en œuvre de systèmes de soins de santé avec une compréhension démontrée des systèmes de santé, de la complexité de l’exploitation et des répercussions sur les soins aux patients
* Solides compétences en leadership, y compris la prise de décisions, la capacité d’influencer sans autorité officielle et la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes dans des environnements matriciels
* Expertise démontrée dans la gestion de l’ambiguïté et la mise en œuvre de méthodes de gestion du changement et de pensée axée sur les systèmes
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes à un éventail de publics (du personnel clinique à la haute direction)

**Atouts**

* Diplôme d’études supérieures en administration des affaires, en gestion des soins de santé ou dans un domaine connexe
* Formation avancée ou certification en gestion du changement et en science de la mise en œuvre

Une connaissance avancée de l'anglais est requise, car vous serez appelé(e) la plupart du temps à interagir en anglais avec des parties externes (par ex. clients, fournisseurs ou partenaires externes); à interagir en anglais avec des parties internes (par ex. collègues ou parties prenantes); et à travailler dans un environnement informatique anglais dans le cadre des tâches liées à ce poste dont la portée est nationale.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

Excellent communication & IT skills.
