Title: Specialist - Schedules Planning
Description:
MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE: To provide specialist expertise in the development, optimisation, implementation and delivery of the Operating Plan, with an equal focus on regular schedule planning and cargo and freighter schedule planning ensuring schedules, aircraft rotations and schedule changes are operationally viable and aligned with available aircraft, crew, maintenance, airport and slot requirements. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develops and maintains operationally robust schedules across the relevant planning windows, ensuring alignment with the approved Operating Plan and available aircraft, crew and maintenance resources.
* Oversees schedule changes within the tactical planning window and coordinates implementation with Network Control, Engineering Planning, Crew Planning, Airport Services, outstations and Commercial teams.
* Assesses planned aircraft rotations and recommends adjustments that improve aircraft and crew utilisation, operational resilience, connectivity, revenue opportunity and cost efficiency.
* Develops and implements schedule recovery and disruption-mitigation options in response to operational constraints, including aircraft availability, maintenance requirements, crew limitations, airport restrictions and Notice to Airmen (NOTAMs).
* Manages tactical slot requirements arising from schedule changes, monitors slot utilisation and supports the protection of historic rights in accordance with applicable slot rules.
* Ensures accurate and timely publication of approved passenger schedules to the Corporate Schedules Repository and downstream systems, including validation of schedule data, Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM) messaging and relevant partner or codeshare updates.
* Acts as a Planning Subject Matter Expert and advanced user of scheduling systems, including Sabre AirVision, maintaining master reference data, supporting users and driving improvements in tools, controls and planning processes.
* Provides technical guidance to Senior Officers and Officers, quality-assures complex schedule planning outputs and prepares management insights covering schedule performance, aircraft utilisation and key operational risks.
* Acts as the Schedules Planning focal point for cargo schedules, translating approved cargo flying requirements into operationally viable flight schedules and aircraft rotations within the wider network plan.
* Develops and maintains cargo schedules in Sabre AirVision, ensuring flight details, frequencies, timings, aircraft assignments and operating patterns are accurately created and controlled.
* Builds and checks cargo aircraft rotations to confirm operational continuity and alignment with aircraft availability, maintenance requirements, ground times, airport operating restrictions and other identified constraints.
* Coordinates cargo schedule requirements with Cargo, Flight Operations, Engineering, Network Control, Crew Planning, Airport Services, Ground Handling and relevant outstations before implementation.
* Secures and manages the airport slots, traffic rights, permits and operational approvals required for cargo operations, coordinating slot changes, monitoring utilisation and tracking requirements to support schedule delivery, protect applicable historic rights and ensure are in place before schedule implementation.
* Loads, validates and publishes approved cargo flights through Sabre AirVision, the Corporate Schedules Repository and applicable downstream schedule distribution processes, including the required SSIM messages.
* Manages amendments to published cargo schedules, checking the impact on aircraft rotations, slots and approvals and ensuring changes are accurately communicated to systems and operational stakeholders.

* Bachelor's Degree (3+ years)
* Bachelor’s Degree in Airline Management, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research or a related discipline preferred.
* Fluent in English
* Relevant experience in airline schedules planning or operations planning, including hands-on responsibility for schedule construction, aircraft rotation checking, airport slots, operational approvals and schedule publication. Experience supporting cargo or freighter schedules is preferred.
* Advanced user of airline scheduling software, preferably Sabre AirVision or Lufthansa NetLine. Strong knowledge of IATA SSIM messaging and standards, airport slot coordination principles, and schedule data publication. Experience with analytical and reporting tools is preferred.
* Years of experience required: 7 - 9 years

* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability & Commitment to achieve
* Resilience and Flexibility (Can do attitude)

External job description  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Do you want to manage supplier relationships in the invoice payment lifecycle? Do you consider yourself well-versed in the world of telecom billing reconciliation, Accounts Payable, program management and vendor relationships? If so, the AWS Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) Business Operations team at Amazon is looking for an experienced professional to provide support of payment, operations and capacity by managing the invoice to payment lifecycle for our global backbone, interconnect and metro fiber circuits increasing our capability to optimize network cost efficiency around the world.  
  
As part of the Business Operations team, you’ll use the levers of process and technology to help our GCID team influence and hold supplier partners accountable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

**Mandate Overview**

Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Business Management, the Associate is accountable for the planning, delivery and continuous improvement of Global Asset Management early talent and learning programs. The role manages assigned programs end to end, from design and annual planning through stakeholder coordination, participant experience, execution, measurement and sustainment, in alignment with broader business priorities. The Associate also supports key events, employee engagement initiatives and selected strategy-development priorities across the business. This may include research, analysis, executive materials, planning coordination and performance insights. The successful candidate will bring structure to complex initiatives, independently advance multiple workstreams, develop solutions and recommendations based on business and stakeholder needs, and use data and feedback to improve program outcomes.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**Early Talent & Learning Programs**

* Manage the annual planning, design, coordination and delivery of early talent programs, including recruitment-cycle support, onboarding, program calendars, participant development, rotations or placements, networking and engagement activities, and end-of-program evaluation.
* Deliver assigned learning and development initiatives, including School of ROC, the Annual Conference and AWCC, as well as other business learning programs and events assigned to the team.
* Develop integrated program plans that define objectives, scope, audiences, milestones, roles, dependencies, communications, risks and measures of success, and support implementation from planning through sustainment.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including business leaders, people managers, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, facilitators, speakers, vendors and participants, to provide business context and enable seamless delivery.
* Manage program logistics and the participant experience, including schedules, invitations, materials, registrations, room or virtual-platform requirements, attendance, follow-up and issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain playbooks, templates, calendars, trackers and other tools to support consistent, repeatable and scalable program execution.
* Monitor and track participation, feedback, completion, program outcomes and other key measures; prepare dashboards, updates and recommendations for leadership and address issues as they arise.
* Analyze participant and stakeholder feedback, business needs and external practices to identify emerging issues, trends and opportunities and recommend improvements to program design, content and delivery.
Support program promotion and engagement through clear, audience-appropriate communications and materials that align with broader business objectives.  

  

**Events & Employee Engagement**

* Support the planning and execution of leadership meetings, employee events, town halls, conferences and other engagement initiatives in alignment with broader business priorities.
* Coordinate event content, communications, speakers, materials and implementation logistics across multiple stakeholders.
* Develop presentations, briefing materials, key messages and other content to support leaders, participants and effective decision-making.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure events and engagement activities align with business priorities, stakeholder needs and communications objectives.  

  

**Stakeholder & Business Management**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with business leaders and partners across the organization, acting as a relationship manager for assigned programs and initiatives.
* Coordinate across teams to establish alignment on objectives, deliverables, timelines and communications, and keep stakeholders informed of recommendations, decisions and progress.
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, updates and recommendations based on an understanding of the business strategy and stakeholder needs to support leadership discussions and decision-making.
* Facilitate meetings and working sessions, coordinate resulting actions and follow-up, and help resolve issues or risks that could jeopardize delivery.
* Proactively identify opportunities and enablers to improve coordination, communications, execution and organizational effectiveness.
Break down business problems and analyze data and information to provide insights, solutions and recommendations that consider broader business implications.  

  

**Strategy Development & Business Management**

* Support selected strategy-development and annual-planning activities through research, analysis, coordination and synthesis of inputs.
* Conduct competitive, industry and internal business analysis to identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks and implications for Global Asset Management and inform strategic recommendations.
* Help translate strategic priorities into clear initiatives, milestones, owners and measures of success, and support implementation across relevant business partners.
* Prepare presentations, briefing materials, discussion documents and executive updates for strategy reviews and leadership decision-making.
* Support KPI frameworks, scorecards, performance reporting and the tracking of business wins and accomplishments; monitor progress and identify issues requiring attention.
Partner with the Director, Strategy & Business Management on priority initiatives and special projects, with scope calibrated to protect delivery of core early talent and learning responsibilities.  

  

**Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Maintain accurate program documentation, status reporting and supporting records to enable effective oversight and decision-making.
* Support appropriate governance, approvals and escalation of risks and issues, identifying key enablers and delivery concerns early.
* Ensure work is completed in accordance with applicable policies, standards, procedures, laws, regulations and risk requirements.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
Support a strong risk and control environment by applying sound judgment, making risk-informed decisions and escalating matters as appropriate.  

  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Typically 4-6 years of relevant experience and a post-secondary degree in business or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail and critical thinking.
* Experience managing programs or projects, preferably involving early talent, learning and development, employee experience, events or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
* Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders and resolve conflicting demands.
* Strong relationship-management, collaboration and influencing skills, including comfort working with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation-development and facilitation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to break down complex issues and use data, research and feedback to develop insights and recommendations.
* Ability to consider the broader business context, bring structure to ambiguity, exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to an effective, inclusive and high-quality participant experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with program-tracking, survey or learning platforms is an asset.
Knowledge of Global Asset Management, financial services or investment-management businesses is an asset.  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Early talent and learning programs are well designed, professionally delivered and aligned with business and talent priorities.
* Participants, people managers and partners have a clear, consistent and positive program experience.
* Program plans, milestones, risks, decisions and outcomes are visible, actively managed and aligned with broader business objectives.
* Participation, feedback and outcome data are translated into practical improvements, insights and recommendations for leadership.
* Strategy-development assignments are completed with clear analysis, concise materials and reliable execution, without compromising core program delivery.
* Program processes, tools and governance become more scalable, consistent and efficient over time, with issues identified and addressed promptly.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect
Description:

Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Python or a comparable programming language, APIs, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate network infrastructure, operational platforms, telemetry, data, and business workflows.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their practical application to automation, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and communicate effectively with tech.hnical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with Cisco NSO or comparable orchestration platforms, including service modelling, lifecycle management, device integration and reusable automation components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telecommunications, service-provider, or other large-scale, mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of network orchestration, assurance, observability, and automation platforms, including Cisco Crosswork.
* Experience establishing engineering governance and reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, streaming technologies, data platforms, and AIOps.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle management, and security-by-design.
* Experience mentoring software engineers and helping organizations adopt modern software-engineering practices.
* Nature of work: Onsite Full time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
* Application start and end date: 27th October for 4-5 weeks

This role will shape the software foundations for scalable network automation and intelligent operations. The successful candidate will combine architecture leadership with practical engineering expertise, helping transform automation into secure, reusable capabilities that deliver sustained operational value.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.

------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.

* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.

  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**
A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.
  
  
The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.
  
  
The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.
  
  
Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

**Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

**Travel Security Risk Management**

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

**Crisis & Emergency Management**

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

Required Languages
  
  

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. **Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.

* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Title: Provider Operations Specialist
Description:
**Build better healthcare together**

Maple’s purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We’re Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we’re proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what’s possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you’ll do work that changes lives—including your own.

### **The role**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll help keep Maple's provider network running smoothly across three areas: Provider Success, Network Performance, and Process Operations.

You'll support everything from provider onboarding and billing to platform updates, performance monitoring, and internal team coordination. You'll work with teams across Maple to solve problems, keep day-to-day operations on track, and find ways to make our processes simpler and more efficient.

### **Your responsibilities**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll:

* Respond to provider questions and resolve operational issues promptly.
* Coordinate provider onboarding to ensure a smooth experience from start to finish.
* Coordinate provider communications, ensuring providers have the information and support they need.
* Support platform setup and configuration, including updates to specialties, provider segments, and product features.
* Support platform testing and quality assurance to ensure everything works as intended.
* Support provider billing and payment processes.
* Coordinate administrative activities related to provider complaints.
* Track regulatory updates and support recurring operational processes.
* Act as a point of contact for internal teams, handling routine requests through channels like Slack and escalating more complex issues.
* Contribute to maintaining team documentation, trackers, procedures, and knowledge base resources to keep information accurate and up to date.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows.

### **What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days, you'll:**

* Build strong relationships with your team and key partners while learning Maple's systems, workflows, and provider network operations.
* Get comfortable supporting day-to-day activities across Provider Success, Network Performance, Process Operations, and Team Administration.
* Start handling provider and internal support requests, onboarding activities, billing tasks, and other recurring processes with increasing independence.

**In 12–18 months, you'll:**

* Be a trusted resource for providers and internal teams, independently owning a wide range of operational tasks and knowing when to escalate issues.
* Take ownership of recurring processes across billing, onboarding, reporting, platform configuration, and team coordination.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows, helping the team work more efficiently and deliver a better provider experience.

### **What you bring**

* An undergraduate degree in business, commerce, health administration, communications or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in an operations support role or similar.
* Foundational experience conducting varied operational work and following established processes to resolve routine issues.
* Strong organization — you can work on multiple workstreams carefully, keep moving parts on track and maintain accurate records.
* A proactive communication style — you keep partners informed, flag issues early and make it easy for the team to know where things stand.
* Strong written communication skills — you can respond to inbound inquiries clearly, warmly and professionally.
* Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills — you can balance recurring work with ad-hoc requests, resolve what you can and know when to escalate.
* A collaborative, service-oriented mindset — you enjoy connecting people, teams and work streams.
* Comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently — you look for opportunities to simplify tasks, improve workflows and make everyday work easier.

Play to your strengths. Finding the right fit goes both ways—so this section is yours to complete. When you join, you'll add the unique strengths you bring that aren't captured above.

### **How we'll support you**

We recognise our people's health is everything. That's why we take care of them.

* **Maple for you and your family:** 24/7 access to general practitioners, pediatrics and mental health therapy for you and your family. Care starts on day one
* **Comprehensive health coverage:** Medical, dental and life insurance because your peace of mind—and your loved ones—matter most
* **Health spending account:** Extra funds to cover the essentials that make a difference, from new glasses to specialised therapy
* **Flex benefits:** An annual budget built for your growth and well-being. Use it for professional development, wellness expenses or a one-time boost to your retirement savings. You choose what matters most
* **Health days:** Life happens. We provide 10 dedicated days for rest, medical appointments or caregiving, so you can show up at your best
* **Destination days:** Work from anywhere. Enjoy the flexibility to work internationally in eligible countries for up to five days per year
* **Group retirement savings plan:** We're here for the long haul. Invest in your future with our group retirement plan

### **The details**

* **Job type:** New role, full-time
* **Hiring manager:** Manager, Provider Network Operations
* **Location:** Hybrid, 500 King Street West, Toronto
* **Start date:** December 2026
* **Vacation:** 3 weeks
* **Pay range:** $56,000 – $63,000

Title: Home Care Community Liaison/Marketer
Description:
Home Care Community Liaison/Marketer (HCLM)

We are seeking an energetic person who can help grow our company, which includes developing and maintaining established account relationships with health facilities and other entities such as case managers, hospitals, discharge planners, Assisted Living Facilities, Nursing Homes, Day programs, Medical Offices, senior centers, and Community centers

**Position Summary**
====================

The Home Care Community Liaison / Marketer is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with referral sources, community organizations, healthcare facilities, and the general public to promote the agency's home care services and drive referral growth. This role serves as the face of the agency in the community and plays a critical part in increasing census, expanding market presence, and ensuring that patients and families are connected to the right level of care. The ideal candidate is an energetic, self-motivated professional with a strong knowledge of the New York home care landscape and a passion for helping others.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Referral Development & Sales**
--------------------------------

* Identify, cultivate, and maintain relationships with referral sources including hospitals, skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), assisted living facilities, physicians, discharge planners, social workers, and case managers
* Conduct regular in-person visits to referral partners to promote agency services, share updates, and strengthen relationships
* Develop and execute a territory-based marketing plan to meet monthly and quarterly referral and census goals
* Track referral activity, conversion rates, and revenue generated from marketing efforts using CRM or agency tracking tools
* Respond promptly to referral inquiries and ensure a smooth handoff to the intake team
* Represent the agency at community events, health fairs, senior expos, and networking functions throughout the NY region

**Community Outreach & Education**
----------------------------------

* Conduct educational presentations to community groups, senior centers, faith-based organizations, and civic groups about available home care services
* Build partnerships with community-based organizations (CBOs), Area Agencies on Aging (AAAs), Independent Living Centers, and MLTC plan care managers
* Distribute marketing materials including brochures, flyers, and agency information to targeted referral sites

---------------------------------------

* Assist with planning and coordinating agency-hosted community events, open houses, and appreciation activities
* Contribute to agency newsletter content, testimonials, and success stories (with appropriate HIPAA compliance)

**Collaboration & Internal Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Work closely with the intake, nursing, and administrative teams to ensure referrals are processed quickly and accurately
* Participate in weekly marketing/business development meetings and provide referral pipeline updates
* Communicate referral source feedback to clinical and operational leadership to improve service delivery
* Assist in onboarding new referral partners by providing orientation to agency services, intake process, and contact information
* Support patient and family inquiries in the field, connecting them to appropriate agency staff as needed

-----------------------------

* Maintain accurate records of all marketing visits, contacts, and outreach activities in the agency CRM or tracking system
* Submit weekly and monthly marketing activity reports to the Director of Business Development or Administrator
* Track and analyze referral source data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for growth
* Monitor competitor offerings, pricing, and market positioning to inform agency strategy

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Public Health, Social Work, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred; equivalent work experience considered
* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in home care marketing, healthcare sales, community outreach, or a related field
* Working knowledge of New York State home care services including CHHA, LHCSA, CDPAP, and Private Duty Nursing
* Familiarity with NYS Medicaid, Managed Long Term Care (MLTC) plans, and Medicare home care benefits
* Proven track record of building referral relationships and meeting or exceeding census/growth goals
* Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and public speaking skills
* Valid New York driver's license and reliable vehicle for field-based work
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

* Monthly and quarterly census growth targets

Title: Operations Controller
Description:
About the Company:

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that's shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role:

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

Central to this key role is your ability to execute day-of-operations network control for assigned flights, missions or regions within the published IOCC control  
window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

A core part of the role is monitoring the flying program, aircraft rotations, and operational systems to identify emerging risks early. Material issues must be escalated promptly so the right decisions can be made at pace.

Working closely with internal teams, stations, handling partners, and external agencies, the role coordinates approved actions from operational readiness to flight completion. This includes managing delays, cancellations, diversions, technical events, weather disruption, and airport or airspace constraints.

With responsibility for operational data integrity, this position ensures flight movements, aircraft assignments, delays, remarks, and event records are updated accurately in real time. The role also supports stakeholder notifications, handovers, operational reports, and aircraft allocation information in line with approved procedures.

You can expect to help coordinate slots, landing permissions, overflight permissions, and related approvals when operational changes require them. The position also supports special operations such as positioning flights, aircraft deliveries, inaugural services, charters, training activity, and functional check flights.

*At the center of a fast-moving operation, your judgment, precision, and calm coordination will help keep our network resilient every day.*

About You:

Diploma qualified at minimum, you will demonstrate a minimum of 4 years of experience in airline operations within an IOCC/OCC, network control, flight dispatch, crew control, operations planning, airport operations, or a comparable environment.

We’d love to hear from you even more if you have possession of a valid Flight Dispatcher License.

You will bring strong operational monitoring, disruption recovery, and prioritisation skills, along with clear communication, sound procedural discipline, systems confidence, and excellent attention to detail under pressure.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

First Nations peoples have lived on this part of Turtle Island for millennia, stewarding the land, the water and all that contributes to life in this region. Today, the culture and presence of First Nations, Inuit and Metis peoples enrich the lands and people of this territory.

Over two centuries ago, the Mississauga people welcomed settlers to this territory, providing sustenance and engaging in trade and commerce. Between 1781 to 1820, eight treaties were signed with the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation who opened their territory to settlement. Today, Sheridan campuses are located on Treaty 14, also known as the Head of the Lake Purchase of 1806 and Treaty 22 and 23 of 1820.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Microsoft CSP Specialist supports the reliable delivery of Microsoft cloud operations across the customer lifecycle, including CSP quote preparation, onboarding and provisioning, renewal readiness, subscription and agreement maintenance, and recurring operational reporting. Supporting a portfolio of 300+ CSP customers, this role is measured on accuracy, responsiveness, cycle time, and data integrity.

This is a specialized cloud operations role that works from defined intake channels, documented runbooks, policies, and controls. The consultant partners closely with Sales and Sales Operations to translate validated requests into accurate quotes and service actions, and coordinates with Finance to support purchase-order validation, billing readiness, and accurate system records. Customer-facing communication remains with Sales and Customer Success, while this role identifies exceptions, documents findings, and routes issues to the appropriate owner for resolution.

**SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**Service Delivery**

* Prepare Microsoft CSP vendor quotes from validated requests received through the CSP intake queue, in accordance with the CSP Quoting Policy.
* Validate product types, SKU eligibility, term and billing model, quantity, and pricing inputs before the quote is structured.
* Build and maintain standardized quoting templates within CPQ to improve accuracy and speed-to-quote.
* Deliver finalized vendor quotes internally to Sales and Sales Operations, who own customer presentation and communication.
* Flag non-standard requests — custom terms, month-to-month structures, mid-term changes, zero-dollar internal orders — for review rather than improvising a solution.
* Execute new-customer setup: reseller relationship links, GDAP and Partner Center role assignment, tenant validation, and Lighthouse/PEC configuration.
* Confirm a valid internal purchase order exists before any order is placed or tenant is provisioned.
* Create and maintain the corresponding agreement and configuration records in ConnectWise Manage and downstream systems.
* Verify provisioned products against the signed quote and the sales order before confirming activation.
* Complete the documented internal handoff to the Customer Success Manager after provisioning is verified.

**Renewal Operations and Reporting**

* Maintain a rolling 90-day forward-looking CSP renewal forecast with weekly completion, so Sales, Lifecycle, and Customer Success have consistent visibility into upcoming workload.
* Generate renewal tickets, environment data, and renewal reporting on the established milestone cadence (approximately 90 / 60 / 45 / 30 / 7 days).
* Produce renewal quotes to meet the 45-day delivery expectation, including multi-SKU and multi-line bundled renewals that require additional preparation and revision handling.
* Process approved renewals, validate the PO, and align the resulting agreement records.
* Escalate at-risk, silent, or non-responsive renewals to the CSM and Sales on a defined trigger rather than absorbing the risk in Operations.

**Systems and Billing Operations**

* Ensure all required CSP subscription, agreement, and customer data in ConnectWise Manage is accurate, complete, and current.
* Maintain consistent records across ConnectWise Manage, Microsoft Partner Center, the distributor portal, and NetSuite.
* Identify and correct data-hygiene issues that create downstream renewal or reporting errors.
* Produce recurring operational reports and dashboard inputs on the defined schedule.

**Process Improvement**

* Work consistently from documented SOPs, controls, checklists, and handoff definitions; escalate when a documented process no longer matches reality.
* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, and validation rules.
* Identify repetitive, rules-based tasks that are candidates for automation, and support the build and testing of Power Platform automations or AI agents that reduce manual effort.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, and lookups.

**Who are we?**

Influencer is a global creator marketing agency on a mission to shape the future of marketing by humanizing brands. By placing creators at the center, the agency delivers creator-first solutions across creative, media, and commerce that connect brands with audiences through insight-driven creator campaigns built to stop the scroll and drive measurable impact.

Founded in 2015 by YouTuber-turned-entrepreneur Caspar Lee and entrepreneur Ben Jeffries, Influencer is the world’s largest independent creator marketing agency - powered by a unique ecosystem of proprietary technology, platform partnerships, and longstanding talent relationships.

As an Official Global Marketing Partner of TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Snap, Meta, and Twitch, Influencer delivers bespoke, enterprise-level solutions powered by Waves, its AI-driven operating system. From concept to conversion, the agency blends human instinct with platform intelligence to drive measurable outcomes across the full funnel - from brand perception to performance and sales.

With 200+ team members speaking 30 languages across North America, Europe, and the Middle East, Influencer has delivered 6,000+ campaigns for leading brands including Spotify, SharkNinja, Google, Nike, Disney, and Coca-Cola.

**Job title**

**VP of Product**

**Reporting of the role**

COO, Chief Operating Officer

**Overview of the job**

The VP of Product leads Influencer's product team and owns the product strategy, portfolio roadmap and product operating model across all of our products.

This is a senior leadership role with direct line management of the product team. We're looking for a product leader who can set a clear direction across multiple products, build and develop a high-performing team, and hold a consistently high bar for what we ship while staying close enough to customers, users and the detail to make good calls.

You'll be responsible for three distinct but connected product areas:

* **Waves:** our customer-facing SaaS platform and the centrepiece of how Influencer is positioned as a technology business. Its core journey runs Discover Assess Shortlist Share Manage Outreach.
* **Ocean:** Influencer’s operating system
* **Internal agency tools:** the systems that make our people faster and our delivery more consistent, scalable and profitable across thousands of campaigns and multiple markets.

The bigger opportunity is to make these products work as one coherent platform rather than a set of separate tools: shared data, connected workflows and a consistent experience for clients, creators and our own teams.

You'll work hand in hand with the Product Strategy team to turn Influencer's strategy and vision into product execution, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, PSO, GTM, commercial and agency delivery leadership, and represent Product at the senior leadership table.

**Measures of success - in the first few months, you will have:**

* **Product Strategy:** A clear, compelling product vision and an integrated portfolio roadmap, developed with the Product Strategy team, backed by the leadership team and visibly executed against.
* **Team Strength:** A well-structured, high-performing product team with clear ownership, strong hires in place, healthy retention and visible career growth.
* **Product Delivery:** High-impact improvements ship consistently, on a predictable cadence and to a strong quality bar across every product.
* **Platform Coherence:** Waves, Ocean and internal tools increasingly share data and connect into one consistent experience.
* **Adoption & Engagement:** Clients actively use and return to Waves and other customer-facing products; internal teams rely on our tools day to day.
* **Customer Value:** Our products demonstrably improve how customers discover, evaluate and work with creators.
* **Operational Impact:** Internal tools measurably improve agency delivery speed, consistency and margin.
* Commercial Impact: Product contributes to client acquisition, retention, expansion and new revenue.
* **Technology Positioning:** Influencer's technology becomes a visible, compelling part of how the company goes to market and stands out in the creator marketing technology landscape.

**Roles & responsibilities:**

**Lead & Build the Product Team**

The product team is the main lever for everything else in this role. You'll build a team that can own its areas with confidence and ship to a high standard without needing you in every decision.

* **People Leadership:** Line manage, coach and develop Product Directors, Product Managers and adjacent product roles (Design, Analytics) across Waves, Ocean and internal tools.
* **Team Design:** Shape how the team is structured, by product, journey or customer, and evolve it as the portfolio and business grow.
* **Hiring:** Attract and hire strong product talent, raising the bar with each hire and building a team that reflects a multi-market business.
* **Performance & Growth:** Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, run performance conversations and build visible career paths for product people.
* **Ownership & Autonomy:** Give each product lead clear ownership of outcomes, then hold them to a high standard on judgement, quality and delivery.
* **Culture:** Build a hands-on, low-ego, customer-obsessed product culture where people get close to users and the detail.

**Own the Product & Portfolio**

Influencer needs a single, coherent product direction across customer-facing and internal products. This role decides where we invest, what we stop, and how the products fit together.

* **Product Vision:** Own the overall product vision and strategy, shaped in collaboration with the Product Strategy team and aligned with the CEO, Engineering leadership and the wider business strategy.
* **Strategy into Execution:** Partner with the Product Strategy team to translate company strategy, market analysis and long-term vision into product bets, roadmap priorities and measurable outcomes and feed delivery learnings back into the strategy.
* **Portfolio Roadmap:** Own an integrated roadmap across Waves, Ocean and internal tools, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, operational efficiency and long-term platform quality.
* **Investment Decisions:** Allocate team capacity across products and make clear calls between competing priorities, including what not to build.
* **Platform Coherence:** Connect the products through shared data, consistent design and linked workflows, so the whole is more valuable than the parts.
* **Market & Competitive Insight:** Understand the influencer marketing, creator technology and SaaS landscape, drawing on the Product Strategy team's market and competitive analysis to identify where Influencer can differentiate.
* **AI Strategy:** Lead how AI, recommendations, smarter search and automation are applied across the portfolio for clients in Waves and for our own teams in internal tools.
* **Data as an Advantage:** Make the most of Influencer's unique data from 6,000+ campaigns and 90,000+ contracted creators, turning it into product capability competitors can't easily copy.

**Run a High-Performing Product Operating Model**

You'll set how product work is done at Influencer, from discovery to release, so teams ship high-impact work consistently and to a strong quality bar.

* **Product Process:** Define a lightweight, effective way of working across discovery, definition, build, testing, release and iteration.
* **Engineering Partnership:** Work as a close partner to Engineering leadership on planning, capacity, technical trade-offs and delivery.
* **Design & UX Quality:** Set the bar for product and UX quality across the portfolio, and personally review key experiences before they ship.
* **Standards:** Establish the standards the team works to strong PRDs, clear problem framing, defined outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* **Metrics & Goals:** Set outcome-based goals for each product area and track adoption, engagement, retention, efficiency and commercial impact.
* **Feedback Loops:** Build the habits and tooling that combine product data, customer feedback and commercial insight into better decisions.
* **AI-Native Ways of Working:** Lead the adoption of AI development and prototyping tools within the product team to test ideas faster and get closer to the product.
* **Communication:** Keep the business informed on product direction, progress and trade-offs through clear roadmaps, reviews and updates.

**Turn Technology into Commercial & Operational Advantage**

Our products should be a reason customers choose, use and stay with Influencer and a reason our agency teams deliver better work, faster.

* **GTM Partnership:** Work with PSO, commercial and GTM leaders to translate market feedback into priorities and shape how products are demonstrated, packaged and positioned.
* **Technology Positioning:** Make Influencer's technology visible to the market and establish the company as a technology-led business within creator marketing.
* **SaaS Growth:** Drive adoption, engagement and retention of Waves and other customer-facing products, and identify opportunities for expansion and new revenue.
* **Agency Efficiency:** Partner with agency, campaign and operations leadership to make internal tools a measurable driver of delivery speed, quality and margin.
* **Internal Customers:** Treat our own teams as customers, understanding their workflows, removing friction and driving adoption of internal tools.
* **Build vs Buy:** Make clear decisions on where Influencer builds proprietary technology and where it integrates or buys.
* **Executive Voice:** Represent Product at leadership level, in front of key clients and partners, and in the wider market.

**What you will need:**

* 10+ years' experience in Product Management, including 5+ years leading product teams at Head of Product, Director or VP level.
* Proven experience hiring, managing and developing product managers and product leaders, including managers of managers.
* Strong track record owning the strategy and roadmap of a customer-facing B2B SaaS product, ideally alongside internal or operational platforms.
* Experience leading a multi-product portfolio, making investment trade-offs and keeping products coherent as they scale.
* Demonstrable experience setting up or improving a product operating model: process, standards, goals and rituals that helps teams ship consistently.
* Strong product and UX judgement, with the ability to identify friction, simplify complex journeys and hold a high quality bar.
* Experience with search, discovery, recommendations, marketplaces, CRM, workflow tools or data-rich products would be particularly valuable.
* Experience within martech, adtech, creator/influencer technology, social platforms, marketplaces or tech-enabled services businesses would be advantageous, but is not essential.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including adoption, engagement, retention, expansion and customer value, and of operational metrics for internal tools.
* A clear point of view on how AI, recommendation systems, automation and smarter search can transform both customer products and internal workflows.
* Technically fluent enough to partner with Engineering leadership on architecture, data, APIs, integrations and build-vs-buy decisions.
* Strong commercial judgement and an understanding of how product strategy connects to GTM, customer retention, margin and business growth.
* Experience working with strategy or business planning teams to turn vision into executable roadmaps, and confident influencing senior stakeholders, presenting to leadership and clients, and saying no without simply building whatever is requested.
* Analytical and comfortable combining product data with qualitative customer insight.
* Hands-on, low ego and willing to get into the detail when it matters; a leader who stays close to the product.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, multi-market business.

Together, MFV and MFA operate one of the largest Latino civic engagement infrastructures in the country, with programs across Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, and Washington, D.C.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Field Manager supports MFPS and its clients, including Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción, by overseeing a team of canvassers conducting voter outreach and civic engagement activities within Latino communities.

Working with the Field Director, this position helps develop and implement voter-outreach strategies involving door-to-door canvassing, phone banking, text messaging, digital outreach, voter registration, voter education, and other approved direct-contact methods.

The Field Manager recruits, trains, schedules, coaches, and supervises field employees; establishes daily and weekly performance goals; monitors data quality and reporting; and ensures compliance with voter-engagement, safety, timekeeping, and organizational requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Monitor field implementation and make operational adjustments within delegated authority.
* Identify barriers, staffing needs, resource constraints, and performance gaps and communicate them to the supervisor.
* Ensure field activities appropriately distinguish between and align with the legally permissible work of MFV and MFA.
* Ensure persuasion, electoral, or other partisan activities are conducted only for an organization legally permitted to engage in those activities.
* Promote accurate, respectful, culturally responsive, ethical, and non-misleading community engagement.

* Supervise and support canvassers, canvass leads, and other assigned field employees.

* Monitor attendance, timekeeping, productivity, quality, conduct, safety, and compliance.
* Provide employees with regular feedback, coaching, recognition, retraining, and professional-development support.
* Motivate employees to meet or exceed approved voter-contact, recruitment, registration, and engagement goals while maintaining quality.
* Identify employee development needs and provide appropriate coaching or escalate as needed.
* Address performance, attendance, conduct, scheduling, safety, or workplace concerns in coordination with the supervisor and Human Resources.
* Promote a professional, inclusive, collaborative, culturally responsive, respectful, and accountable team environment.
* Ensure employees accurately record all time worked and receive required meal and rest periods.

### **Recruitment, Onboarding, and Scheduling**

* Assess field staffing needs based on approved campaign goals, timelines, budgets, and anticipated workload.
* Collaborate with Human Resources and authorized hiring managers on recruitment, interview, selection, and onboarding activities.

* Develop staff schedules, shift assignments, supervisory coverage, transportation plans, and contingency plans.
* Ensure new employees complete required onboarding, voter-registration, safety, data, technology, timekeeping, and job-specific training.
* Coordinate access to approved systems, equipment, identification, materials, scripts, and field resources.
* Monitor staffing levels, attendance, turnover, and capacity and recommend appropriate changes.
* Avoid making employment, compensation, scheduling, or disciplinary commitments beyond delegated authority.

### **Training and Staff Development**

* Develop and provide training for canvassers and other assigned field employees.
* Train employees on approved scripts, voter outreach, voter registration, voter education, phone banking, text messaging, digital tools, and field procedures.
* Train employees to use electoral databases, canvassing applications, dialers, texting platforms, and other approved systems.
* Provide training concerning data entry, quality control, reporting, field safety, situational awareness, de-escalation, and incident response.
* Develop guides, presentations, scripts, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other training materials.
* Evaluate employee understanding and provide additional coaching or retraining as necessary.
* Communicate the purpose and importance of accurate data, ethical outreach, respectful engagement, and compliance.
* Maintain required training attendance and completion records.

### **Community and Voter Engagement**

* Engage community members directly in English and Spanish through approved voter-contact and civic engagement activities.
* Provide accurate, non-misleading, and approved information regarding voter registration, voter education, elections, and civic participation.
* Use only authorized scripts, materials, forms, tools, and calls to action.
* Model effective, culturally responsive, and respectful outreach practices for field employees.
* Respond to routine community questions and refer legal, policy, media, complaint, or other complex matters to the appropriate supervisor.
* Respect individuals who decline participation or ask that outreach end.
* Protect voter and community-member privacy.
* Represent MFPS and its clients professionally within assigned communities.
* Avoid making promises or organizational commitments beyond delegated authority.

### **Performance Goals and Accountability**

* Set, monitor, and support achievement of approved daily, weekly, and campaign-level field goals.
* Track direct voter contacts, doors knocked, successful conversations, phone calls, text messages, registrations, commitments, and other assigned metrics.

* Cooperate with quality-control reviews, audits, investigations, and corrective-action processes.

* Implement and enforce applicable workplace and field health, safety, security, and operational protocols.

* Document and report incidents according to established procedures.
* Avoid making legal, media, medical, law-enforcement, or employment decisions beyond delegated authority.
* Cooperate with post-incident reviews and corrective or preventive measures.

* Collaborate with state leadership and campaigns, programs, data, communications, digital, operations, and Human Resources employees.
* Coordinate staffing, technology, materials, data, training, messaging, and other resources required for field implementation.
* Maintain professional and constructive relationships with community partners and other stakeholders.
* Support rapid-response activities, voter-registration deadlines, election-cycle operations, and special projects.
* Travel to field sites, organizational locations, partner sites, and community events as required.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

### **Education**

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience)

* 2–3 years OR 2+ major cycles in civic engagement/campaign leadership.
* 1-2 years managing multi-tiered teams and senior staff.

* Ability to design, maintain, evaluate, and improve goal-oriented accountability structures.
* Strong data-management, quality-control, reporting, and analytical skills.
* Ability to use and train employees on VAN, MiniVAN, EveryAction, canvassing applications, dialers, texting platforms, or comparable systems.
* Strong strategic-planning, project-management, organizational, and time-management skills.

The Enterprise Customer Experience organization is aligned to the customer journey, with the customer at the center. This role provides senior leadership across three teams that work together to serve our customers throughout their Paychex journey:

+ Champion a culture that puts customers first, leads with expertise, and delivers outcomes, influencing cross-company agreement on how to deliver the greatest value and close the gap between perceived and actual customer experience.
+ Act as an organizational change agent, driving initiatives that prepare the company for continued growth by enhancing internal workflows, systems, and practices.

+ Provide exceptional leadership and guidance to direct reports, fostering an energized, motivating, and high-performance work environment.
+ Perform essential leadership functions, including coaching, mentoring, and managing performance to achieve key business outcomes and create growth opportunities for team members.
